notes.title: 09/25 Patch Details (Updated on 09/22 06:30 AM UTC / 09/21 11:30 PM PDT)
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/6ee0ecd4a50a03fd2f1d3198c7945dd015450c7c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Masters of the Book,[/p][p][/p][p]As the relentless summer heat begins to subside, the autumn breeze brings with it a new update coming in 09/25.[/p][p][/p][p]In this update is the release of the Overseer of Elation, Diana, who in her childhood chose to become a monster in order to survive violence and fear. Now she stands at the top of the food chain, defining herself only through domination and destruction.[/p][p][/p][p]This update also adds a new difficulty to Portrait of Thierry - Glorious Era, alongside a couple more balance changes, with specific spotlight on Sarka and Rebecca.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve also made changes to make your experience smoother! A reorganized Adventure Guide, smoother animations alongside new filters for sorting.[/p][p][/p][p]Of course we couldn’t forget the usual slew of events and rewards! As the autumn winds begin to blow, so too does the strong gale of rewards we’ve prepared just for you, our Masters of the Book![/p][p][/p][p]Want more details regarding all these? More information is available below:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Knight of Veda[/b][/h3][p][b]* For the featured 5★ Knight of Veda, your suffering is her joy.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/d22fe91ffa1b143e9f793eadd3f0c759e5d903c5.png"][/img][/p][h2][i][b]“Armies, I'm here!”[/b][/i][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]To survive, she had to become a monster. To grow stronger, she had to trample others. Ruins remained wherever she stood, and screams echoed with each footstep. After proving herself through domination and destruction, she set out to hunt her newest prey: the world[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]- Diana is a Fire-type Melee DPS who wields a Greatsword.[/p][p]- Her Normal Skill “Hymn of Agony” attacks with a sweeping slash and a downward strike. With each cast, she loses HP but gains “Sadism”, which provides ATK Boost and Fire DMG Boost.[/p][p]- Her Signature Skill “Strike of Elation” allows her to leap above her enemies' heads and deliver a powerful downward strike. She can consume her “Sadism” to restore HP, gaining “Exhilaration,” which grants “Normal Skill DMG Boost” and  "Intimidation," which grants “Increased Durability.” (Updated on 09/22 06:30 AM UTC / 09/21 11:30 PM PDT)[/p][p][/p][p]- Diana alongside her Signature Weapon “Song of Ashes” can be obtained via Call of the Stars. While her Signature “Reigning Halo” and her Signature “El Cid of Cruel Warmth” can be obtained via “Mark of the Sworn Loyalty” and “Fragments of the Painting” respectively, which can be found on the “Guidance of the Goddess” menu.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* The Flower of Oblivion returns as a featured 5★ Knight.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/bd3b58627d78346ca4981543e938d48f5a94e01d.png"][/img][/p][p]- She has forgotten everything in the constant experiments inflicted upon her, but Bluebell persists, and this time there will be no more suffering.[/p][p]- Bluebell is a Blood-type Melee Support who uses a Greatsword that inflicts \[Increased Blood DMG] on enemies she hits, with a random chance to inflict the \[Bleed] status effect.[/p][p][/p][p]- “Bluebell” alongside her Signature Weapon “Blood Flower Sword” can be obtained via Call of the Stars. While her Signature Halo “Dreadful Halo” and her Signature El Cid “El Cid of Lost Name” can be obtained via “Mark of the Sworn Loyalty” and “Fragments of the Painting” respectively, which can be found on the “Guidance of the Goddess” menu.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ A new difficulty for Portrait of Thierry - Glorious Age![/b][/h3][p][b]* The new difficulty “Imperishable Age” will be added in this update.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/2cd72bb0c678a419826ea1408b5c2d31273e8220.png"][/img][/p][p]- In “Imperishable Age,” enemies will have higher HP and deal more DMG than the previous stage.[/p][p]- The difficulty consists of 2 floors, with a boss clear granting you 12,000 progress points.[/p][p]- The “Unfinished Chronicles” Insignia will be given to you as reward upon first clear.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* Imperishable Age will have its own rank leaderboards![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/d8ac7892d683141901a231f4e10da72bfbbe5d15.png"][/img][/p][p]- When clearing Imperishable Age, your progress, that is clear time, will be tracked and put on a leaderboard.[/p][p]- You can view the Knight composition the Players ranked in the leaderboard used.[/p][p]- No separate rewards are provided for this leaderboard.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* New Graces alongside some adjusted ones will be added to Portrait of Thierry and the Portrait of Thierry: Glorious Age.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/cd26f63f14b3adeb1aa3139328b5296628aefdd7.png"][/img][/p][p]- The Lena Elrod Grace for Portrait of Thierry will be adjusted.[/p][p]- Four (4) Brilliant Graces and 1 Power of the Fallen Book will be added as exclusives to Glorious Age.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/35ec14a9ffc7e81c26722b3aef25697efac57c38.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ A reorganized Adventure Guide arrives with this update![/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/bbd15241c0f5c0f7d6d5be232b6b19139aa6a039.png"][/img][/p][p]- A new section will be added to the Adventure Guide that allows players to view multiple types of content at a glance. Daily, weekly, and seasonal content will be categorized and displayed on the screen.[/p][p]- You can immediately check a brief progress status of each content, and jump directly to it.[/p][p]- For content that supports Sweep, the sweep function can be used immediately.[/p][p]- The Footsteps of the Past tab, which previously displayed only select content, will be removed. Content such as Adventure, The Beast’s Nest, and Veda’s Nightmare can now be found under the second tab titled "Dungeon".[/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Combat Visual Effects Options added![/b][/h3][p][b]* Skill effects and Knight outlines can now be adjusted to increase visibility and info clarity during combat.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/32f576f46611021f00a20fdfd0bb73419fd35435.png"][/img][/p][p]- These visual effect settings can be adjusted on Settings > Combat.[/p][p]- In this menu, among other things, you can now hide the skill effects for other players who joined your session during Normal Combat. There is also an option to display only the effects from the currently controlled Knight during Squad Combat.[/p][p]- Through the outline adjustment feature for Knights, you can select which outlines to display during Normal Combat, or select to display only the outline of the controlled Knight during Squad Combat.[/p][p]- These options only apply to content where an option to manually control the Knights exists.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Balance[/b][/h3][p][b]* Another set of Knights of Veda will be up for adjustments.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/d519d145cc6c7b1cdaff960f57a906c22aa07679.png"][/img][/p][p]- In this update, the Knights of Veda Sarka, and Rebecca will be adjusted.[/p][p]- Going forward, we plan to make these Knight of Veda adjustments more regularly through our monthly updates.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/51c109ca4489d9b87ef75e855244931e292d41cd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]* Balance adjustments for Shadow Waters and Ancient Giant incoming![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/b9a1dea5b501d5a37b625ecd218f636a4f4edc30.png"][/img][/p][p]- The HP and Resistance of the boss monsters featured in Shadow Waters and Ancient Giant will be increased.[/p][p]- You’ve all become too powerful for these supposedly fearsome monsters! That’s why we’re giving them a bit of a leg (or tentacle) up with some adjustments to their stats. We know this will be kinda controversial so rest assured that we’ll be on a special lookout for everyone’s feedback on this change to see if any more adjustments are needed![/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Improvements[/b][/h3][p][b]* Craft better food! Be the Gourmet you always were and strengthen your Knights before they march into battle![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/b92720050e66459ea7c308aeedb4278c755e3a95.png"][/img][/p][p]- Food that used to be only obtainable via chance can now be crafted directly![/p][p]- Higher-tier dishes can be cooked using the lower-tier versions of these dishes plus some gold.[/p][p]   eg.) 6 Grilled Meat plus 100 Gold will be needed to craft a single Special Grilled Meat.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* Improvements to the How to Obtain buttons for items will be made![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/65c81bde910cd3b0033101a5ec698591fc5a410e.png"][/img][/p][p]- Selecting acquisition paths for items that used to transfer you to their location before opening the selected menu, will now just display the menu itself. This will greatly speed up the process and remove a significant amount of time juggling between menus and loading screens.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* Items for cleanup and those under lock and key can now be sorted![/b][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/38d02e84011e241e4560589af57103b190907d30.png"][/img][/h3][p]- Sort filters for items that are Locked or marked for Cleanup will be added.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* Improvements to Guild Siege related to joining are on the way![/b][/p][p] - You will now be able to participate in the next possible Guild Siege after leaving and joining another Guild.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* The level-up animation on Reward Decree will be removed.[/b][/p][p]- The level-up animation on Reward Decree will be removed, decreasing the time it takes to obtain and claim rewards.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Events and Seasonal Content[/b][/h3][p][b]* In celebration of this year's harvest, we're launching the Golden Field Festival event![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/4b000b36649b21a9a8d1d2493027b459486a8ddc.png"][/img][/p][p]- During the event, you can collect Tri-Colored Half-Moon Rice Cakes by clearing Adventure Dungeons[/p][p]- You can collect up to 20 Tri-Colored Half-Moon Rice Cakes daily[/p][p]- Rewards will be based on the number of rice cakes collected during the Golden Field Festival.[/p][p]- The event will run from 09/25 after the maintenance until 10/30 before the maintenance.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* Autumn's Bounty of Gifts brings the fun of Harvest Moon Festival straight to you![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/3f34cd759bde5f6bb9257889482862090b5b711c.png"][/img][/p][p]- Log in daily for 7 days during the event period to receive various rewards![/p][p]- The event will run from 09/25 after the maintenance until 10/30 before the maintenance.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* Join us in an adventurous mission event, A Moonlit Autumn Night[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/3705b0179da4b48824d5acb23a46b0fa2c3cfccb.png"][/img][/p][p]- Complete the various missions and earn rewards which include niceties like Splinter from the History, Solvent of Prayer, Crystals of Destiny, Galactic Bliss and Starstones![/p][p]- The event will run from 09/25 after the maintenance until 10/30 before the maintenance.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* “Blessing in the Battlefield” will be held once again, doubling your Arena Survival rewards![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/55604c20282b024365fed30b55c557695ba002fb.png"][/img][/p][p]- During the event period, rewards from Arena Survival will be doubled![/p][p]- The “Blessing in the Battlefield” event will be held from after the maintenance on 09/25 until before the maintenance on 10/30.[/p][p][/p][p]- The “Survival Pass” will be available in two phases during the event period. You can access it via the button on the bottom of the Arena Survival screen, on the “Guidance of the Goddess” screen, or via the “Content Pass” menu. If you purchase the Survival Pass Goddess’s Reward Decree and complete the missions, you will earn the “Gem of All Things,” allowing you to select a Mythic Gem of your choice with the highest possible stat.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/2ef5df9622a0204889bcef499f5db94e4e9a7c01.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]* Join the ‘Simon’s Amazing Gifts’ event! Work together with your Guild members to defeat treasure chests and claim exciting rewards.[/b][/p][p]- The “Simon’s Amazing Gifts” event can be participated in every Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday at 08:00 PM during the event period, at the Guild Territory.[/p][p]- Various rewards can be obtained from this event, and for this current iteration: the new mascot “Chai” can be earned.[/p][p]- “Simon’s Amazing Gifts” will run from 10/09 to 10/26.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* A new “The Fruits of Adventure” Daily Attendance event is upon us![/b][/p][p]- Receive various rewards depending on the number of days you logged in.[/p][p]- “The Fruits of Adventure” event will run from 10/01 06:00 AM UTC / 09/30 11:00 PM PDT to 11/01 06:00 AM UTC / 10/31 11:00 PM PDT.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* The "Blessing in Adventure" event is back to shower everyone with more rewards![/b][/p][p]- During the event period, you can earn double the rewards from Adventure Dungeons up to the daily limit.[/p][p]- The double rewards event for Adventure Dungeons will run from after the 09/25 Maintenance until 10/16 03:00 AM UTC / 10/15 08:00 PM PDT.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* The Calydon’s Blessing event will be there to sate your hunger for Gold![/b][/p][p]- During the event period, your Calydon’s Hideout rewards will be doubled![/p][p]- The Calydon Blessing event will be held from after the 09/25 Maintenance until 10/16 03:00 AM UTC / 10/15 08:00 PM PDT.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* Veda’s Nightmare deepens as the rewards for braving its halls increase, the “Blessing in Nightmare” event returns![/b][/p][p]- During the "Blessing in the Nightmare" event, you can earn double rewards from “Veda's Nightmare” and on “Nightmare of the Abyss” up to the daily limit.[/p][p]- The "Blessing in the Nightmare" event starts on 10/16 06:00 AM UTC / 10/15 11:00 PM PDT and will end before the regular maintenance on 10/30.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* A new Reward Decree season will start.[/b][/p][p]- The new Reward Decree season will begin on 10/01 06:00 AM UTC / 09/30 11:00 PM PDT, and will run until 10/30 06:00 AM UTC / 10/29 11:00 PM PDT[/p][p]- When you purchase Neejarem’s Reward Decree you will be able to obtain up to Ruby x2,280, Crystal of Fate x30, Solvent of Prayer x2, and much more![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/44e7b3f2c007fc766add6f6b69b9d9c6ba796f82.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]* A new season of Arena will begin.[/b][/p][p]- During this Arena Season, you can earn rewards such as Emotes and Insignia based on your progress.[/p][p]- This Arena Season will end before the regular maintenance on 10/30.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* Battlefield of the War Gods gets a much-needed refresh![/b][/p][p]- Battlefield of the War Gods rankings will be reset, and season-highest ranking rewards can once again be obtained![/p][p]- This season will end before the regular maintenance on 10/30.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* A new season of Portrait of Thierry will be starting.[/b][/p][p]- After the maintenance, the attributes of the monsters on each floor of Portrait of Thierry will be changed.[/p][p]- The new Portrait of Thierry season will end before the regular maintenance on 10/30.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* A new season of Nightmare of the Abyss will be starting.[/b][/p][p]- With the new season, a new set of Abyss Trials will be applied to each stage.[/p][p]- The new Nightmare of the Abyss season will end before the regular maintenance on 10/30.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* A new season of “Beast Battlefront” arrives.[/b][/p][p]- A new featured boss will arrive in this refresh of Beast Battlefront![/p][p]- "Beast Battlefront" content will be held twice during the season. The schedule is as follows:[/p][p]  - 1st Round: 09/25 06:00 AM UTC / 09/24 11:00 PM PDT ~ 10/07 06:00 AM UTC / 10/08 11:00 PM PDT[/p][p]    - Settlement until 10/09 06:00 AM UTC / 10/10 11:00 PM PDT[/p][p]  - 2nd Round: 10/16 06:00 AM UTC / 10/15 11:00 PM PDT to 10/28 06:00 AM UTC / 10/27 11:00 PM PDT[/p][p]    - Settlement until 10/30 06:00 AM UTC / 10/29 11:00 PM PDT.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Store[/b][/h3][p][b]* A new set of store packages have arrived to help you on your journey![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/13a8aa815087530899ace7a2102a6a89e83c565b.png"][/img][/p][p]- The “Harvest Budget Pack” offers the best bang-for-your-buck when you’re on the hunt for more Crystals of Destiny![/p][p]- Need more? Get 500 (yes) Crystals of Destiny with plus essential Relic Synthesis materials with the “Harvest Destiny & Relic Pack.” (Updated on 09/22 06:30 AM UTC / 09/21 11:30 PM PDT)[/p][p]- If you want those Crystals of Destiny AND Crystals of Fate, the “Harvest Destiny & Fate Pack” has you covered![/p][p]- These packages will be available until October 16, 2025 03:00 AM UTC /  October 15, 2025 08:00 PM PDT.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* In celebration of Diana’s release, we’ve prepared a couple of packages to help you set her up![/b][/p][p]- A Halo, El Cid package that will help you in getting the relevant equipment.[/p][p]- A Growth Package with items to help you level her up plus some Crystals of Destiny will also be available.[/p][p]- A special package with the needed enhancement materials for Diana will also be available![/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][p] - An issue where the Knight’s Portrait was not displayed on equipped equipment when you’re using a Knight’s Robe will be fixed.[/p][p] - An issue where the incorrect popup would sometimes appear when checking the Collection when on Todburg or on Guild Territories will be fixed.[/p][p] - An issue where the Gold reward for Adventure Stage 10-6 was lower compared to other areas will be fixed.[/p][p]- A phenomenon where certain issues occur with Guild Sieges after leaving a Guild and then joining a new one while one is in progress will be fixed.[/p][p]- An issue where enemies would sometimes not appear when on a Co-Op Battle will be fixed.[/p][p][/p][p]We will continue to listen to your feedback to ensure an even more enjoyable adventure in ASTRA: Knights of Veda.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: Second Half of 2025 Update Roadmap
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/e515a758da7db351e3ac3ad6e50dc31e708de0c6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Masters of the Book,[/p][p][/p][p]This is Kim Young-mo, the director of ASTRA: Knights of Veda.[/p][p][/p][p]It’s been some time since we last saw each other, since then a lot of new stuff has come into the game. We hope these new and exciting additions have increased your enjoyment of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]As we move through the rest of the year, we will continue striving to deliver new and exciting content for our Masters of the Book![/p][p][/p][p]So without further ado, let’s take a look at what the rest of the year has in store for ASTRA: Knights of Veda.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ ASTRA: Knights of Veda Update Roadmap[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/e92f93b891bfbe36ec83e7ee9724894a27b8952c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]New regions and stories are opening up, and new companions await your arrival. We kindly ask for your continued anticipation and support.[/p][p][/p][p]To all Masters of the Book who have stood by us all throughout, we would like to express our sincerest thanks. We will continue crafting a journey worthy of your expectations.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p][/p][p][b]※ The information stated was provided to help our Masters of the Book understand our upcoming content schedule. More precise details will be given regarding content names and specifics through the patch notes.[/b][/p]

notes.title: 09/01 Patch Announcement
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/e515a758da7db351e3ac3ad6e50dc31e708de0c6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Masters of the Book,[/p][p][/p][p]A patch was released on 09/01 that will address the following issues. In order for the patch to be downloaded and applied to your game, please make sure to restart the game.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Unscheduled Patch Announcement[/b][/h3][p]* [b]Date:[/b] 09/01 10:40 AM (UTC) / 03:40 AM (PDT)[/p][p]* [b]Patch Details:[/b][/p][p] - An issue where the incorrect audio effect was being played when switching from a Mythic-grade Elossa while on Adventure Stages has been fixed.[/p][p] - An issue where the effects displayed on the Fortress did not match it’s HP during Guild Siege has been fixed.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Notes[/b][/h3][p]* If your game is not updated, content that requires other players (Co-op, Arena) may be problematic.[/p][p]Please make sure to restart the game to download the patch before engaging in these contents.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank You[/p]

notes.title: Event Character “Elossa” & Exclusive Weapon Appearance Rate UP Event
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/935678ff33ab4226ca32b643272e2cbd66abf1ed.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][i][b]“My sword is the only thing that defines me”[/b][/i]
[i][b]「Swordsmaster of the Veil Elossa」 RATE UP ![/b][/i][/h2][p][/p][p]Masters of the Book,

“Swordsmaster of the Veil Elossa” and “Blade of Kin-Slaying Aslan” come to you during this event.

For a limited time, the 5★ Knight of Veda “Swordsmaster of the Veil Elossa,” and “Blade of Kin-Slaying Aslan” alongside their respective weapons have a 100% chance to appear. Additionally, the summon rates for 4★ Knights of Veda “Ardor”, “Iris”, and their exclusive weapons will be increased.

Experience what the limited characters can offer in “Journey in Memory” and earn rewards while doing so.[/p][h3]
[b]■ Pickup Hero Event[/b][/h3][p][b]* Event Period[/b]
- August 28, 2025 after the maintenance ~ September 25, 2025 before the maintenance

[b]* Event Introduction[/b]
- During the event period, participating in the [b]"Pickup Hero Event: Swordsmaster of the Veil," [/b]and [b]“Pickup Hero Event: Blade of Kin-Slaying” [/b]guarantees a 100% appearance rate for the respective [b]5★ Knight of Veda, “Swordsmaster of the Veil Elossa,” [/b]and [b]"Blade of Kin-Slaying Aslan."[/b]
  : The Pickup Hero Event Knights of Veda “Swordsmaster of the Veil Elossa,” and "Blade of Kin-Slaying Aslan" will not be added to the regular Call of the Stars afterwards.
 - During the event period, when proceeding with the [b]"Pickup Hero Event: Swordsmaster of the Veil," and “Pickup Hero Event: Blade of Kin-Slaying” [/b]the appearance rates of the [b]4★ Knight of Veda “Arrows of Storm Ardor” [/b]and [b]"Prideful Child Iris" [/b]will increase.
 - If a 5★ does not appear during the respective Pickup Hero Event, points towards the Grace of the Holy Grail accumulate, and once full, the next Pickup Hero Event guarantees to obtain the featured 5★ Knight of Veda.
  : Grace of the Holy Grail Points accumulated through the Pickup Hero Event will be maintained even after the event period ends, and can be used in the next Pickup Hero Event.
 - Users can try out the Knights on this Pickup Hero Event through the “Journey in Memory” Event.
  : Various rewards can be earned from completing the event.
 - Detailed information about the Call of the Stars can be found by clicking the '?' button at the top left of the Call of the Stars screen.
 - Detailed information about the acquisition rates can be checked through the '%' button at the bottom left of the Call of the Stars screen.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/fb1635b18e7e95e85a3779fc4ee5389689dfecfd.png"][/img][/p][p]
[b]■ Pickup Exclusive Weapon Event[/b][/p][p][b]* Event Period[/b]
- August 28, 2025 after the maintenance ~ September 25, 2025 before the maintenance

[b]* Event Introduction[/b]
 - During the event period, participating in the [b]"Pickup Exclusive Weapon Event: Oath on a Small Sword," [/b]and [b]“Pickup Exclusive Weapon Event: The Blade Hidden Beneath the Shield of Oaths”[/b] guarantees a 100% appearance rate for the respective [b]5★ Weapons, “Nameless (Longsword),” [/b]and [b]“Broken Oaths (Sword & Shield).”[/b]
  : The Pickup Exclusive Weapon Event Exclusive Weapon “Nameless (Longsword),” and “Broken Oaths (Sword & Shield)” will not be added to the regular Call of the Stars afterwards.
 - During the event period, when proceeding with the [b]"Pickup Exclusive Weapon Event: Oath on a Small Sword," [/b]and [b]“Pickup Exclusive Weapon Event: The Blade Hidden Beneath the Shield of Oaths,” [/b]the appearance rates of the [b]4★ Weapons, “Death Cry (Large Bow)” [/b]and [b]“Land of Pride (Wand & Orb)”[/b] will increase.
 - If a 5★ does not appear during the Pickup Exclusive Weapon Event, points towards the Grace of the Holy Grail accumulate, and once full, the next Pickup Exclusive Weapon Event guarantees to obtain the featured 5★ Exclusive Weapon.
  : If a 5★ Exclusive Weapon  is obtained before the Grace of the Holy Grail is full, the accumulated points will be reset.
  : Grace of the Holy Grail Points accumulated through the Pickup Exclusive Weapon Event will be maintained even after the event period ends, and can be used in the next Pickup Exclusive Weapon Event.
 - Detailed information about the Call of the Stars can be found by clicking the '?' button at the top left of the Call of the Stars screen.
 - Detailed information about the acquisition rates can be checked through the '%' button at the bottom left of the Call of the Stars screen.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/e85ac52dd43b071f8e366a7c0edf06fbb9ae8719.png"][/img][/p][p]
[b]■ Journey in Memory[/b][/p][p][b]* Event Period[/b]
- August 28, 2025 after the maintenance ~ September 25, 2025 before the maintenance

[b]* Event Details[/b]
- Unlock the adventure by completing Chapter 1, Stage 2, and then join through the "Guidance of the Book" event tab.

[b]* Event Highlights[/b]
- Tral characters come with predetermined levels, gear, and relics, ensuring a seamless battle experience.
 - The composition of your party and the equipment or relics of your characters are set for the trial stages and cannot be altered.
 - Replay the trial stages as many times as you like. However, trial stage rewards can only be claimed once.
 - Certain features will be restricted during the trial stages.
[b]
* Participation Rewards[/b][/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/016ca2eb85e4c2301cf1601fda3983995ba373a0.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]
[b]* Notes[/b]
 - After clearing the stage, you must click the \[Claim Reward] button to receive the rewards.
 - The rewards received will be directly credited to your in-game inventory.
 - Rewards not claimed within the event period will be lost.
 - For more detailed event precautions, refer to the [url="https://account.hybeim.com/en/policies/service/astra/event-policy"][b]<Event Policy>.[/b][/url] [/p][p align="start"]
Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: Blessing in Adventure (Double Rewards) Event Notice
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/6ac807d764eb8645c593238d1697d0f1cc331d9d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Masters of the Book,

The Blessings of the Goddess rain down on you, as you'll be able to receive double the Growth Material rewards for clearing Adventure Stages.

Thank you.
[/p]

notes.title: “Apparition’s Rush” Event Notice
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/3062cef1ae388fef9639433b30e47812007042c6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Masters of the Book,

As you take a rest and sleep, a nightmare begins to wash up in the recesses of your mind, of a “Supply Wagon” that cannot be delivered to anyone.[/p][p]
Fight against boss monsters in this nightmarish event, overcome the challenges and you will be rewarded with various abundant rewards.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Event Period[/b][/h3][p]* August 28, 2025 after the maintenance - September 11, 2025 02:59 AM UTC / September 10, 2025 07:59 PM PDT[/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ How to Participate [/b][/h3][p]* The event will be available for access upon completing Chapter 5, Stage 4 at the Adventure Zone.
* In the "Guidance of the Book," you can access the "Apparition’s Rush" event page by clicking ‘Participate’ or by entering through the "Apparition’s Rush" button located to the left of ‘Veda's Nightmare’ at the bottom-right corner of the Cloister of the Holy Grail.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Event Details[/b][/h3][p]* Escort the carriage to the designated destination within the time limit before the supply count reaches zero.[/p][p]* After clearing the previous stage, you will be able to challenge the next one.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Event Rewards[/b][/h3][p]* Rewards for the "Apparition’s Rush" event are determined based on the time remaining upon completing the supply transport.[/p][p]* If you complete each stage within 70 seconds, you will receive an additional [b]"Potion of Sunset."[/b][/p][p]* You can check the target times and rewards in the "Challenge Goals" section at the bottom right of the Apparition’s Rush stage screen.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Notes[/b][/h3][p]*  Rewards for clearing each stage will be directly sent to your in-game inventory.[/p][p]*  Event details may change in the future, and any changes will be notified through this notice.[/p][p]*  For more detailed information and precautions regarding the event, please refer to the [b][url="https://account.drimage.com/en/policies/service/astra/event-policy"]<Event Policy>[/url][/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: 8/28 Update Server Maintenance (Updated 8/28 07:40 AM UTC / 12:40 AM PDT)
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/4016b32cd9575429ab24027a2bab5efc1afe64e7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]\[Complete][/b][/p][p][/p][p]Masters of the Book,[/p][p][/p][p]The 8/28 maintenance has been completed, and now is your time to turn a new page on your adventures through Planis.[/p][p][/p][p]This update is available on both PC platforms. We hope that you enjoy these latest updates to the game.[/p][p]* PC: The update will be downloaded and installed automatically upon launching the game.[/p][p][/p][p]If you are having any issues while playing the game, please make sure to report them through our Customer Support Center.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank You.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Masters of the Book,[/p][p][/p][p]We would like to inform you about the server maintenance scheduled for August 28, 2025.  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ 08/28 Maintenance[/b][/h3][p][b]* Period: [/b][/p][p]　- 08/28 03:00 AM - [strike]09:00[/strike]　07:40 AM (UTC)[/p][p]　- 08/27 08:00 PM - 08/28 [strike]01:00[/strike]　12:40 AM (PDT)[/p][p][b]* Target:[/b][/p][p]　- All Servers[/p][p][b]* Notes:[/b][/p][p]　- The game will not be accessible during the maintenance.[/p][p][b]* Details:[/b][/p][p]　- A new Knight of Veda, additional content, bug fixes, and system improvements.[/p][p]　- For more details about the update, please check the patch notes: [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2484250/view/535484522556294908?l=english"]👉 Link[/url][/b] [/p][p][/p][p][b]■ Maintenance Rewards[/b][/p][p][b] - Item:[/b] Starstone x300[/p][p][b] - Distribution Period:[/b] [/p][p]　August 28, 2025 after the maintenance - August 29, 2025 02:59 PM (UTC) / 07:59 AM (PDT)  [/p][p][/p][p][b]■ How to Obtain the Rewards[/b][/p][p]* Access Belle Menu → Mail → Receive Items[/p][p]* The mail and items will expire within 7 days.[/p][p]* Make sure to log in to the game during the distribution period in order to obtain the rewards.[/p][p]* If you cannot find the rewards in your mail, please restart the game.  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Notes[/b][/h3][p]* During the maintenance, both PC and Mobile versions will be inaccessible, and the Coupon page will also be unavailable.[/p][p]* Maintenance time may be changed depending on the circumstances. Any changes will be announced in this notice.[/p][p]* To ensure that your game data remains safe, please make sure to close the game before maintenance begins.[/p][p][/p][p]Once the maintenance has been completed, further information will be provided through this notice.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: 08/28 Patch Details
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/543e8add3fdcbe6189fa46978998f1bbe559c631.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Masters of the Book,[/p][p][/p][p]A gentle breeze is beginning to blow as Summer winds down. As autumn nears, so too does the new content coming your way![/p][p][/p][p]In the update scheduled for August 28, the Swordsmaster of the Veil, Elossa, will appear alongside a new Hero’s Quest.[/p][p][/p][p]A young knight of Todburg who always stood by Finar’s side ever since the day she was saved by him, her life’s goal has become protecting him. Her desire to protect and her own will is conveyed through her sword, guiding her forward. In addition, her Hero's Quest, will let you investigate a mysterious disappearance case occurring in Todburg.[/p][p][/p][p]Alongside Elossa, some Knights such as Death Crown, Aslan, and Saeya will get their time to shine.[/p][p][/p][p]This update will also introduce “Guild Sieges”, a large-scale Guild-related content where multiple guilds gather to test their strategies and teamwork. Defeat the forces deployed by the opposing guild by forming two parties, which will be deployed to the Guild’s castle, defending it as best they can.[/p][p][/p][p]Improvements to Nightmare of the Abyss and Battlefield of the War Gods to make your experience smoother will also be introduced while some events you may have missed such as Special Supply Delivery and Apparition's Rush make their return.[/p][p][/p][p]More detailed information about the August 28 update will be provided below.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Knights of Veda[/b][/h3][p][b]* Answering the Call of the Stars, 5★ Elossa walks on her own towards her goal[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/519191dba843418634f07616d49c652fbb450d26.png"][/img][/p][h2][i][b]“My sword is the only thing that defines me”[/b][/i][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]She is a young lady knight from Todburg who stands by Finar's side. Beneath her cold exterior, she has a kindness greater than anyone else's. For a long time, she was a girl who only followed orders. But when she realized her wish to protect her loved ones, she started walking her own path. From that day forward, her sword finally became her own, belonging to no one else[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]- Elossa is a Fire-attribute Melee Support. She wields a longsword and casts \[Flames of Justice], which grants party members the \[Fire ATK Boost] effect each time she hits an enemy. Additionally, she has a chance to silence enemies when she hits them[/p][p]- Her Normal Skill \[I Will Not Retreat!] enables her to advance and attack with horizontal slashes, dealing DMG and engulfing the front in flames. This skill also inflicts \[Flame Wound] on enemies hit, granting the \[Increased Incoming Wound Rate] effect.[/p][p]- Her Signature Skill \[Face an Honorable End!] allows her to swing her sword widely forward, splitting the air and pulling enemies toward her. It also empowers party members with \[Flames of Vision], granting them the \[Fire DMG Boost] effect.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]* 5★ Knight Aslan returns to Call of the Stars[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/238ce1cbf4029950474583e425c1a0ff377bb91c.png"][/img][/p][p]- “Aslan” is an Earth-type Melee DPS who uses a Sword & Shield. He converts his Stamina into Skill DMG to deal powerful DMG and uses his skills to take the initiative in battle.[/p][p]- “Aslan” alongside his Signature Weapon “Broken Oaths” can be obtained via Call of the Stars. While her Signature “Faithful Halo” and her Signature “El Cid of Unwavering Loyalty” can be obtained via “Mark of the Sworn Loyalty” and “Fragments of the Painting” respectively, which can be found on the “Guidance of the Goddess” menu.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Take defensive positions Masters of the Book! Guild Siege is upon us![/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/470b9bd834ce901c8243b59610cfe598425df28f.png"][/img][/p][p]- Guild Siege is a Guild-based PvP content where multiple guilds gather to engage in battles where strategy and teamwork is key.[/p][p]- Season 1 of the Guild Siege will run from after the 08/28 Maintenance until before the 09/25 Maintenance. It will be held three (3) times a week and is divided into three phases, Deployment, Battle, and a one day Break phase. The phases change at 06:00 AM UTC / 11:00 PM PDT daily.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/749cc9f9630e01a7ca969f3a0b7a34180026f2f3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]- During the Defense Deployment Phase, you can deploy your units until 05:00 AM UTC / 10:00 PM PDT, with the matchmaking taking place until before the Phase change. For the Battle Phase, battles are possible until 05:00 AM UTC / 10:00 PM PDT, with the calculation of the battle results ongoing until before the Phase change.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]* Join a Guild to participate in Guild Siege![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/625337b2684bc36983e237aeb3ad81945c45c2be.png"][/img][/p][p]- Guild Siege can be accessed either by talking to Uber Palmer in the Guild Territory, or through the dedicated Guild Siege button on the Belle Menu.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/341f240a4f902517fb7f22e796530fe7bc7f4378.png"][/img][/p][p]- You will have to start the Guild Siege content by entering it during the Defense Deployment Phase, you will not be able to participate for the first time while the Battle or Break Phases are active.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/5286e6d3218aa30cf32468dca75bc4ae9a989605.png"][/img][/p][p]- Two decks/parties will need to be selected and configured to protect your Guild Fortress. You can freely modify your existing decks during the Defensive Deployment Phase by accessing the related button.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]* Allocate your resources and defend your Fortress with strategy![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/cc357b87c1c710eb2c21ce6aa344438a046bf747.png"][/img][/p][p]- Three (3) Fortress are available for each Guild in Guild Siege, each with ten (10) buildings to garrison.[/p][p]- Select the Fortress you wish to modify and you will be given a screen with each of the buildings visible along with the Guild Member assigned to defend it.[/p][p]- Use the Formation Mode button to assign Guild Members on each of the buildings. Only Guild Leaders and Deputy Guild Leaders can make the assignment.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/a87fdd8479a70f3a8501749d63291ad1c0cb4f3d.png"][/img][/p][p]- Each Guild Members deck is visible on the Formation Mode screen to help you with selecting the right one to deploy on each of the buildings.[/p][p]- Clicking the “Auto-Deploy” button will automatically assign Guild Members not yet assigned to any building on an empty one.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]* Engage in Battle with your fellow Guild members![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/470b9bd834ce901c8243b59610cfe598425df28f.png"][/img][/p][p]- During the Battle Phase, you will engage in battle against an opposing guild.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/3b85e802434ccbd0177a37a29e8cd54e0020492d.png"][/img][/p][p]- The opposing guild will also have three (3) Fortresses, which you can select to view its status and the deployed enemy decks.[/p][p]- Once you have decided on which building you want to attack, you can do so for a total of three times.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/07cf82a760e54409b3cd3dab84a80a43b6cdad8c.png"][/img][/p][p]- Each Fortress has ten (10) buildings consisting of one (1) Inner Ward, two (2) Barrier Towers, and seven (7) Outer Wards.[/p][p]- The Inner Ward and the Barrier Towers have higher health than the Outer Wards, but completely destroying them will earn you more points.[/p][p]- The Inner Ward can only be attacked after destroying either of the two Barrier Towers, and the Inner Ward of the Central Fortress can only be attacked after destroying the Inner Ward of either of the two Outer Fortresses.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]* Participate in the Guild Siege and earn great rewards![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/c2bd91f62abe823d3b48a02f9cbe5812566d428e.png"][/img][/p][p]- Battle rewards can be earned when you participate in Guild Siege battles.[/p][p]- Winning or getting a draw on a Guild Siege will give you points which will be used to reduce the HP of the Fortress. The points earned are proportional to the amount of HP a building lost during the battle, with additional points awarded when the building is destroyed during the battle. The Inner Ward and Barrier Towers award higher bonus points when completely destroyed.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]* The winner of a Guild Siege is determined by the total points earned by members of the Guild.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/3fb8f66ab7fd780ed53032f6a6a76299a44157cd.png"][/img][/p][p]- Rewards will be given to the Guild Members who participated based on the results which will be sent via in-game mail before the start of the next Guild Siege.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]* In addition to that, you can also get Ranking Rewards based on your Guild’s Rank![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/68326f5adbb245c368b021b6296fea1f910fbf76.png"][/img][/p][p]- As with the individual Guild Siege itself, the Guild’s overall ranking is based on the cumulative points gained throughout the season. The final ranking will be determined at the end of the last Guild Siege of the season.[/p][p]- Guild Members eligible for the Ranking rewards will be those who participated in the Guild Siege at least once that season. Rewards will be sent via in-game mail.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Elossa’s Hero Mission[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/c35173584a6296c1ebf16a694bab07b4f7352520.png"][/img][/p][p]- A new Hero’s Mission focusing on Elossa will be available with this update![/p][p]- Following the mission instructions, you’ll be heading to an area outside of Todburg to discover a new locale.[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/2256e643be401c9c6665c8c5084bf98802e29cf8.png"][/img][/h3][p]- In this Hero’s Mission, you and Belle will be investigating the disappearance of our beloved porcine friend Bacon! Uncover the mystery behind the disappearance and in the process learn some truths about Elossa herself, all the while earning rewards in the process~[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Balance[/b][/h3][p][b]* Another set of Knights of Veda will be up for adjustments.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/8be456b5c05cd071ecfeff988f6ef0ea7c9942b6.png"][/img][/p][p]- In this update, the Knights of Veda Death Crown, Aslan, and Saeya will be adjusted.[/p][p]- Going forward, we plan to make these Knight of Veda adjustments more regularly through our monthly updates.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/883b01b63a69c6458376ebbb4a29d03a4930143e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Improvements[/b][/h3][p][b]* Farming for Goddess’s Armor? Sick of going up and down stages? Worry no more![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/95d41a86cc150b3f3dc78500dc097afccf256fd5.png"][/img][/p][p]- When you tap “Repeat” in Nightmare of the Abyss, a screen for configuring repeat battles will appear.[/p][p]- Only the current stage or lower stages can be selected. If you proceed after selecting a stage, only the selected stage will be repeated until the set number has been reached or if the stage drops below the selected stage during battle.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]* The Deck Formation screen for some content has been improved![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/cba433a81581744d0980b7d85173e944128a1a58.png"][/img][/p][p]- You can now filter for Role much easier on the Knight of Veda Deck formation screen, with the already selected Knights displayed at the top.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]* Adjustments to the way Food is used and applied on Training.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/47b83dc4644a51ab88671e0f2c5c4b07ae6e012d.png"][/img][/p][p]- After using a food, the effect will now remain until you enter the Training mode. Before, regardless if you enter the Training mode or not, once a food has been selected, it will be consumed and you would need to use it once again.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]* A dedicated screen for all the Content Passes will now be available on the Guidance of the Book menu.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/06dacffc9340962c493d9cff5c52c8774734c9ef.png"][/img][/p][p]- Passes such as the Knight’s Growth Pass and Event Passes have been consolidated into the “Content Pass” screen. You can access it by selecting the tab under the Guidance of the Book menu.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* Less time for entry cutscenes, more time for action![/b][/p][p] - The cutscene that appears when entering Veda’s Nightmare has been removed, allowing faster access.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* Updates on Supported Languages[/b][/p][p]- Five (5) out of the current eight (8) supported languages will be maintained, while three (3) of them will be removed.[/p][p]  - Maintained: Korean, English, Japanese, Traditional and Simplified Chinese.[/p][p]  - Removed: French, Thai, and Russian.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Events and Seasonal Content[/b][/h3][p][b]* Apparition’s Rush and Special Supply Delivery Events return![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/b47aab2734e22a7cb448a4b7b062c8133cddd5e2.png"][/img][/p][p]- Each stage will consist of one (1) round, successfully completing the supply transport will net you various rewards.[/p][p]- “Apparition’s Rush” will be held from after the maintenance on 08/28 until 09/11 03:00 AM UTC / 09/10 08:00 PM PDT.[/p][p]- “Special Supply Delivery” will start on 09/11 06:00 AM UTC / 09/10 11:00 PM PDT and will end before the regular maintenance on 09/25.[/p][p]- Content Passes for both Apparition’s Rush and Special Supply Delivery will be available during their run. Purchasing the Goddess’s Reward Order for these passes allow you to earn a “Scroll of All Things,” which grants you a special enchantment scroll that grants your desired stat with the highest values possible.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/c09cb7ba345772a5409f52143b33107b81e6a6ea.png"][/img][/p][p][b]* The "Harold's Lost Knowledge" event will reward you for helping Harold with research materials.[/b][/p][p]- Collect the materials Harold requires to write his research log from the Adventure Zone stages and submit them to him in Todburg to receive rewards.[/p][p]- The "Harold's Lost Knowledge" event will be unlocked progressively, with one log entry opening each day, and you can check your progress in the Research Log.[/p][p]- The "Harold's Lost Knowledge" event will run from 09/11 06:00 AM UTC / 09/10 11:00 PM PDT until before the 09/25 Maintenance.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* A new “The Fruits of Adventure” Daily Attendance event is upon us![/b][/p][p]- Receive various rewards depending on the number of days you logged in.[/p][p]- “The Fruits of Adventure” event will run from 09/01 06:00 AM UTC / 08/31 11:00 PM PDT to 10/01 06:00 AM UTC / 09/30 11:00 PM PDT.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* The Calydon’s Blessing event will be there to sate your hunger for Gold![/b][/p][p]- During the event period, your Calydon’s Hideout rewards will be doubled![/p][p]- The Calydon Blessing event will be held from after the maintenance on 08/28 until 09/11 03:00 AM UTC / 09/10 08:00 PM PDT.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* Veda’s Nightmare deepens as the rewards for braving its halls increase, the “Blessing in Nightmare” event returns![/b][/p][p]- During the "Blessing in the Nightmare" event, you can earn double rewards from “Veda's Nightmare” and on “Nightmare of the Abyss” up to the daily limit.[/p][p]- The "Blessing in the Nightmare" event starts on 09/11 06:00 AM UTC / 09/10 11:00 PM PDT and will end before the regular maintenance on 09/25.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* A new Reward Decree season will start.[/b][/p][p]- The new Reward Decree season will begin on 09/01 06:00 AM UTC / 08/31 11:00 PM PDT, and will run until 10/01 06:00 AM UTC / 09/30 11:00 PM PDT[/p][p]- When you purchase Neejarem’s Reward Decree you will be able to obtain up to Ruby x2,280, Crystal of Fate x30, Solvent of Prayer x2, and much more![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/629ab26d15be05fe8a40197fb269fe7e9642390e.png"][/img][/p][p][b]* A new season of Arena will begin.[/b][/p][p]- During this Arena Season, you can earn rewards such as Emotes and Insignia based on your progress.[/p][p]- This Arena Season will end before the regular maintenance on 09/25.[/p][p][/p][p][b]* Battlefield of the War Gods gets a much-needed refresh![/b][/p][p]- Battlefield of the War Gods rankings will be reset, and season-highest ranking rewards can once again be obtained![/p][p]- This season will end before the regular maintenance on notes.title: "[Simon’s Amazing Gifts] Guild Treasure Chest” Event Notice
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/28ae856dc0f6a174595b669148fed36a300b8e23.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Masters of the Book,[/p][h2]
[i][b]“My gifts are always SUPER special”[/b][/i][/h2][p]
Simon has brought ‘Fearsome Treasure Chests’ carried on the back of a giant gluttonous turtle to test the cooperation among Guild members.

From Thursday to Sunday at 8PM server time, visit your Guild Territory and join the quest to defeat Fearsome Treasure Chests with your guild members and earn various rewards, including the new mascot  [b]"Truly Romantic Lady."[/b][/p][h3]
[b]■ Event Period[/b][/h3][p]* The event is set to [b]start at 08:00 PM server time on the scheduled dates[/b] below.
 : August 07, 2025 (Thursday) - August 10, 2025 (Sunday) 
 : August 14, 2025 (Thursday) - August 17, 2025 (Sunday) 
 : August 21, 2025 (Thursday) - August 24, 2025 (Sunday) 
* The event will take place a total of [b]12 times[/b] during the event period.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/ca57229170b8e36cd1592e28fb133dc616638d24.png"][/img][/p][h3]
[b]■ Participation Condition[/b][/h3][p]* You can participate in the event after completing the World Mission "Social Party?"
* You can only participate after joining a Guild since this event is exclusively for Guilds.
* You can join the event via the "Simon's Amazing Gifts!" event page under "Guidance of the Book" or from within the Guild territory.[/p][h3]
[b]■ How to Participate & Rewards[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/08d1d3370d08096f31c7ef5c7390371593f18581.png"][/img]* You can participate in the “Simon’s Amazing Gifts!” event page or move to the guild territory starting 5 minutes before the event begins.
* When the event starts, a 'Fearsome Treasure Chest' will appear in the center of the guild territory, and it can only be attacked with 'Normal Attacks'.
* The rewards can be claimed within 2 hours from the time of defeating the Fearsome Treasure Chest.
* Defeating the 'Fearsome Treasure Chest' will cause 30 Treasure Chests to appear, and each guild member can open only one Treasure Chest.
* You can check the reward items of the first treasure chest you choose and decide whether to claim them.
* If you do not select the first treasure chest, you will be allowed to choose a second one.
* You cannot choose whether to claim the rewards from the second chest; once selected, the items will be automatically added to your inventory.
* If you select a treasure chest that another player is currently checking, you will not be able to see the reward items and will receive a message indicating that the chest is being checked by someone else.
* If you have already obtained a Treasure Chest once per day, you cannot receive additional rewards by changing Guilds and re-participating.
* The rewards from the Treasure Chests will not be the same for all Guild members; they will be obtained randomly.
* The mascot [b]"Truly Romantic Lady" [/b]can be obtained by up to 5 guild members, and if you have previously obtained one it will be replaced with Crystals of Fate x10.
* When a Treasure Chest containing the Mascot is opened, a pop-up will display the username of the user who obtained it.[/p][h3]
[b]■ Notes[/b][/h3][p]* The rewards received will be directly credited to your in-game inventory.
* The event can proceed even if all Guild members are not present at the event start time.
* If the 'Fearsome Treasure Chest' is not defeated within the time limit, it will disappear.
* The time period to claim the rewards from the ‘Fearsome Treasure Chest’ may vary depending on when it was defeated.
* After the time for receiving rewards has passed following the defeat of the 'Fearsome Treasure Chest', you will not be able to claim the 'Treasure Chest', and lost rewards will not be given again.
* For more detailed event precautions, refer to the [b][url="https://account.drimage.com/en/policies/service/astra/event-policy"]<Event Policy>[/url].[/b]

Enjoy a weekend with your Guild members, where abundant and diverse rewards await the Master of the Book.

Thank you.[/p]

[b][Complete][/b]

Masters of the Book,

The 8/1 Unscheduled Maintenance has been completed, and now is your time to turn a new page on your adventures through Planis.

This update is available on both PC platforms. We hope you enjoy these latest updates to the game.

If you are having any issues while playing the game, please make sure to report them through our Customer Support Center.

Thank you.

[hr][/hr]
Masters of the Book,

We would like to inform you about the server maintenance scheduled for Augsut 01, 2025.

[h3][b]■ 08/01 Maintenance[/b][/h3]
* Period: 
 - 08/01 07:00 AM - [strike]09:00[/strike]　08:42 AM UTC

Once the maintenance has been completed, further information will be provided through this notice.

Thank you

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/4016b32cd9575429ab24027a2bab5efc1afe64e7.png[/img]

[b][Complete][/b]

Masters of the Book,

The 7/31 maintenance has been completed, and now is your time to turn a new page on your adventures through Planis.

This update is available on both PC platforms. We hope that you enjoy these latest updates to the game.
* PC: The update will be downloaded and installed automatically upon launching the game.

If you are having any issues while playing the game, please make sure to report them through our Customer Support Center.

Thank You.

[hr][/hr]
Masters of the Book,

We would like to inform you about the server maintenance scheduled for July 31, 2025.

[h3][b]■ 07/31 Maintenance[/b][/h3]
[b]* Period: [/b]
 - 07/31 03:00 AM - [strike]09:00[/strike]　08:38 AM (UTC)
 - 07/30 08:00 PM - 07/31 [strike]02:00[/strike]　01:38 AM (PDT)
[b]* Target:[/b]
 - All Servers
[b]* Notes:[/b]
 - The game will not be accessible during the maintenance.
[b]* Details:[/b]
 - A new Knight of Veda, additional content, bug fixes, and system improvements.
 - For more details about the update, please check the patch notes:
    [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2484250/view/496075490169192457?l=english][b] 👉 Link[/b][/url]

[h3][b]■ Maintenance Rewards[/b][/h3]
[b] - Item:[/b] Starstone x300
[b] - Distribution Period:[/b]  July 31, 2025 after the maintenance - August 1, 2025 02:59 PM (UTC) / 07:59 AM (PDT)

[h3][b]■ How to Obtain the Rewards[/b][/h3]
* Access Belle Menu → Mail → Receive Items
* The mail and items will expire within 7 days.
* Make sure to log in to the game during the distribution period in order to obtain the rewards.
* If you cannot find the rewards in your mail, please restart the game.

[h3][b]■ Notes[/b][/h3]
* During the maintenance, both PC and Mobile versions will be inaccessible, and the Coupon page will also be unavailable. 
* Maintenance time may be changed depending on the circumstances. Any changes will be announced in this notice. 
* To ensure that your game data remains safe, please make sure to close the game before maintenance begins. 

Once the maintenance has been completed, further information will be provided through this notice.

Thank you.

notes.title: 07/31 Patch Details (Updated on 07/29 08:56 AM UTC / 01:56 AM PDT)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/8f7dc77e665e48a73f338324853ecbfaf4792a27.png[/img]

Masters of the Book,

As the blazing heat of the summer sun arrived earlier this year,
We hope everyone is taking care of themselves.

And while the heat continues to shine, so does our quest to bring more new and fun content continue!

In this update, the tragic beauty Celestia makes her debut. Tormented by her quest to destroy both the enemies of the Lloyd Papal Court and the self she continues to believe is not worth saving, she works as both a Priest and Executioner. To her, whose worthless life was saved by mortals, gods do not exist.

This update will also introduce the new region "Trondheim," long awaited by many Masters of the Book. This new adventure zone will add 12 new adventure dungeons and one (1) nightmare dungeon for you to explore! This land, once the hope of humanity and the terror of beasts, now only has its frozen walls and ruins remaining, but the secrets slumbering within will stir an unexpected vortex of chaos.

In addition, a new Relic Auto-Dismantle feature will be introduced alongside options to hide pop-ups for a certain amount of time. For this update’s Knight adjustments, it’s Veleno, Aurora, Edward, and Albert’s time to shine.

In the realm of events, the Tower of Trials returns as a new seasonal event alongside the usual slate of events we have prepared for you. We have also prepared a new mascot for you to earn on Simon’s Amazing Gifts!

For more information about everything new or changed coming to this patch, you can check out the rest of the patch notes!


[h3][b]■ Knights of Veda[/b][/h3]
[b]* 5★ Knight of Veda Celestia begins her execution[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/fe9287e13922f68916e27a5d3c3481d4e3edc6e8.png[/img]
[h3][i][b]“…I will begin my execution”[/b][/i][/h3]

[h3][b]She is both a priest and an executioner in the Lloyd Papal Court. Beneath her saintly appearance, she harvests souls with her poisonous touch

As a surviving sinner, she lives each day as if it were a self-imposed punishment. In a world in which she has lost faith, she offers prayers without believing in salvation. Amid condemnation and silence, she slowly erases herself[/b][/h3]


 - Celestia is a Poison-Attribute Melee Healer who uses a Great Axe. Her passive “Soul Harvest” allows her to heal the ally with the lowest health whenever she hits an enemy. Her Normal Skill “Soul Separation Ritual” deals damage to enemies in front of her and applies buffs such as Reduce DMG and Ignore RES to the rest of the party. Her Signature Skill, “Rest From Death,” inflicts AoE damage and grants the “Immortal” effect alongside Wound related buffs.

- “Celestia” alongside her Signature Weapon “Silent Stigmata” can be obtained via Call of the Stars. While her Signature “Soul Harvesting Halo” and her Signature El Cid “Silent Condemnation” can be obtained via “Mark of the Sworn Loyalty” and “Fragments of the Painting” respectively, which can be found on the “Guidance of the Goddess” menu.


[b]* It’s not only her twin sister that can return from… somewhere, 5★ Knight of Veda Dorothea can do that too![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/401cd9de25a80cc506cb859670869138ca22b3c9.png[/img]
- With her twin sister dead under mysterious circumstances, Dorothea joins the Titans Army in her place to avenge it. She now returns once again to Call of the Stars to continue the work she started.
- Dorothea is a Fire-type Ranged DPS with a long gun (Large Bow) that inflicts [Mark] on enemies she hits. When she hits an enemy with [Mark], she removes the enemy's [Mark] and accumulates [Heat] for herself. When her accumulated [Heat] reaches max, she will enter the [Overheated] state and use a devastating explosive attack to destroy enemies.

- “Dorothea” alongside her Signature Weapon “Gemini” can be obtained via Call of the Stars. While her Signature Halo “Burning Halo” and her Signature El Cid “Facade of Serenity” can be obtained via “Mark of the Sworn Loyalty” and “Fragments of the Painting” respectively, which can be found on the “Guidance of the Goddess” menu.


[b]* The Queen of Winter transforms into the Queen of Summer![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/e89cdc5d9f3622d8b7742f8dbaa7363e04bf491d.png[/img]
- A new Knight’s Robe, “Queen of the Summer Night” for Rhynara will now be available.
- As with the previous Knight’s Robe, while “Queen of the Summer Night” is equipped, Rhynara’s appearance will change, and her skill effects will be too to match the new look.
- A Name Card and Profile Icon will come with your purchase of the Knights Robe.


[h3][b]■ New Adventure Zone: Trondheim[/b][/h3]
[b]* A new Adventure Zone will be added to the game.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/e061e324fcfd0595f65d393f7d77f294bbd87a25.png[/img]
- At the northernmost edge of the Principality of Koren lies “Trondheim,” once the hope of humanity and a source of terror for Beasts, now a shattered ruin and a frozen monument to the its eventual fall.
- Masters of the Book who have cleared Chapter 9 of the Adventure Stages will immediately have access to this new region.


[b]* The hunt for Veda’s Heart continues![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/1de84fea5572c78210ffe08b96fb57d7fa3d7e4c.png[/img]
- As part of the new Adventure Zone, the quest for Veda’s Heart continues! By clearing these missions, you will be experiencing the exciting continuation of the main story all the while getting sweet rewards and achievement s along the way


[b]* 12 new Dungeons await you in this new Adventure Zone![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/c82bc4cde2b965c9b3e80758101108cfb2cd7dcc.png[/img]
- The new Adventure Zone will consist of 10 standard dungeons and 2 boss stages.
- We’ve ramped up the difficulty for these dungeons compared to those before it, don’t worry we’ve also increased the quality of the rewards to make beating these new stages even more worthwhile, alongside introducing new Achievements for you to strive towards!
- Ascension Materials can be obtained from the Boss stages alongside possible drops of the new Relic sets “The Fighting Girl” and “Warabu’s Genius Warrior!”
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/40afec20bba3979e87544955f6606e813194f8aa.png[/img]


[h3][b]■ Challenge the new Nightmare stage![/b][/h3]
[b]* A new stage for Veda’s Nightmare and Nightmare of the Abyss will be added.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/d93228ecd1b197d254154bb0bcc7501e5afc7a6d.png[/img]
- After clearing the Lightning Nightmare Palace Nightmare stage, you will now be able to access the new “Nightmare Lift of Fall” Nightmare stage.
- Defeat Asha and obtain Weapon Ascension Materials as well as possibly the new Relic Sets, “Fighter Girl,” and “Warabu’s Genius Warrior.”
- Clear the Nightmare of the Abyss stage and you will have a chance to obtain Support Goddess’s Armor!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/3af843c75d4192ea8524b42105955ec043380e6c.png[/img]


[h3][b]■ New Relic Sets![/b][/h3]
[b]* Two new Relic Sets, “Fighter Girl,” and “Warabu’s Genius Warrior” will be added to the game![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/cc43b9a985e2b96b15a148f005a80e4ef1d0169c.png[/img]
- These two new Relic Sets, like the rest of the currently existing sets, will have five (5) parts and will range from 3★ to 6★ in rarity.
- The Fighter Girl set focuses on Bleed DMG and has set effects that enhance the damage from your Signature Skill alongside the Bleed you inflict on enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/4362eb849a1705f288075fc1159242a990e15094.png[/img]
- The Warabu’s Genius Warrior set meanwhile focuses on Water-attribute DMG but also enhances your Crit DMG and Crit Rate when using Ranged Projectile attacks, with set effects focusing on AoE DMG.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/018d7fd58cb86395e502e395299c25db0c02ba4a.png[/img]


[h3][b]■ Balance[/b][/h3]
[b]* Another set of four (4) Knights of Veda will be up for adjustments.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/18177f47fb4cede1573c982eca52a22c4c49ab7e.png[/img]
- In this update, the Knights of Veda Veleno, Aurora, Edward, and Albert will be adjusted.
- Going forward, we plan to make these Knight of Veda adjustments more regularly through our monthly updates.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/0ddbfab100cd3fc7aa69249aa7daa2f7f09fb0b3.png[/img]


[h3][b]■ Improvements[/b][/h3]
[b]* Improvements to the Relic Auto-Dismantle system[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/d663e493003689fffa53e7dbebb9fafa472b6b6d.png[/img]
- You can access the Relic Auto-Dismantle settings via the Settings menu under the “Misc” tab or via the Dismantle option while in your Inventory.
- While in the settings screen, you will be able to select a minimum Relic Rarity to keep, Relics below the set Rarity will be automatically dismantled upon acquisition.
- Relics on or above the Rarity selected will then be checked if they satisfy any of the Main Options/Stats or Additional-Options/Stats you have selected. If the Relics don’t satisfy the options selected, they will be automatically dismantled.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/b0f4edf65b235b94f6d44f3d614ca2c055d93986.png[/img]
- An icon beside the Additional Options label allows you to either Reset your Selection or use the Quick Apply function. When you use Quick Apply, it will automatically use the same selection on all five Main Options screens.
- As it is currently, Relics obtained from Call of the Stars, Shop, Mail, Crafting and from Tickets will be excluded from Auto-Dismantle.
- After this update, the Relic Dismantle Setting will be automatically adjusted to “Do Not Auto-Dismantle,” please make sure to check your account settings after the update.


[b]* Make the popping Pop-Ups not pop! A new POPular request is now a feature![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/24ee2933bf5cc06e25cbcf3153adc3e20a15c04e.png[/img]
- A new option to disable Pop-Ups from appearing for a period of a week will be added.


[b]* A better experience awaits our Masters of the Book as we make your menu surfing a bit more smooth.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/8cf33a744b54e5612dc5758c8880d8040193bf2c.png[/img]
- Unnecessary pop-up UI elements that were displayed when entering Shadow Waters, Ancient Giant and Beast Battlefront have been removed. In addition, some UI labels have been moved to other areas of the menu to make more efficient use of the space.
- The Rewards screen that appears after clearing a stage in events such as Special Supply Delivery and Apparition’s Rush has been adjusted so that it will now automatically close after a certain amount of time instead of waiting for a deliberate selection of the confirm button to close.


[b]* The Slow-Mo when you activate Overflowing Power of the Stars will be made… faster?[/b]
- The duration of the slow-motion effect when using the Overflowing Power of the Stars will be decreased, allowing for a much smoother combat flow.


[h3][b]■ Tower of Trials[/b][/h3]
[b]* The Tower of Trials has returned, in the form of an event.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/5171a113313671f45a9d3784049d442862795271.png[/img]
- The Tower of Trials event will run twice during the event period:
　- 1st Period: July 31, 2025 after the maintenance - August 14, 2025 03:00 AM UTC / August 13, 2025 08:00 PM PDT
　- 2nd Period: August 14, 2025 06:00 AM UTC / August 13, 2025 11:00 PM PDT - August 28, 2025 before the maintenance.
- During the active period, you can enter the Tower of Trials via the Celestial Trials icon on the World Map.


[b]* Structure & Format[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/06bf72bdab8ce4cf04b136d39e9d9293d3271478.png[/img]
- The Tower of Trials is composed of twelve (12) Floors. Floors 1~4 will require one (1) party of Knights while Floors 5~12 will require two (2) parties of Knights.
- Each Floor contains three rooms, clearing all three allows you to proceed to the next floor. 
- We’ve designed Floors 1~8 to be of manageable difficulty, while Floors 9~12 are designed with a higher difficulty in mind. Please take this into account as you tackle the new Tower of Trials!


[b]* Buffs and Goddess’s Arrangement[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/053379eb206ecbbad944a81031e11524202e80d1.png[/img]
- Each Floors grants a “Goddess’s Arrangement” buff to support you on your journey.
- Before entering each room, you can select one from a choice of three (3) Challenge Prayers to enhance your Knight’s abilities.
- Each floor has a recommended attribute, so building parties of Knight with that attribute will make your journey a much smoother one.
- Due to the increased difficulty of Floor 9~12, Mythic Skills of all Knights of Veda will be activated on those floors.


[b]* A Tower of Trials means a Tower of Rewards.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/b78eaba198da066a360d92ac71e8e2401f771274.png[/img]
- Clearing each room grants Trial Rewards,and completing challenge objectives grants additional Completion Rewards.
- During the event, completing missions will unlock the Tower of Trials Pass, which offers generous rewards. It will open twice, aligned with the event schedule.
- By purchasing the Goddess’s Reward Decree and completing missions, you can obtain the Unsullied Remnants of Relics.


[b]* Unsullied Remnants of Relics[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/57e7956571ad5eef114438a60468d907bc0368df.png[/img]
- This item allows you to select a relic with the highest possible stat values and desired options.
- You can choose the Mythical Relic’s set, part, main option, and sub options directly.
- It will be provided as a Level 20 Relic, and you can choose which sub option receives the enhancement value.
- All values will be applied at the current maximum possible stat.


[h3][b]■ Events and Seasonal Content[/b][/h3]
[b]* Join the ‘Simon’s Amazing Gifts’ event! Work together with your Guild members to defeat treasure chests and claim exciting rewards.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/e1737b33619657b610feca24e877c31bfacf354e.png[/img]
- The “Simon’s Amazing Gifts” event can be participated in every Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday at 08:00 PM during the event period, at the Guild Territory.
- Various rewards can be obtained from this event, and for this current iteration: the new mascot “Truly Romantic Lady” can be earned.
- “Simon’s Amazing Gifts” will run from 08/07 to 08/24.

[b]* A new “The Fruits of Adventure” Daily Attendance event is upon us![/b]
- Receive various rewards depending on the number of days you logged in.
- “The Fruits of Adventure” event will run from 08/01 06:00 AM UTC / 07/31 11:00 PM PDT to 09/01 06:00 AM UTC / 08/30 11:00 PM PDT.

[b]* The "Blessing in Adventure" event is back to shower everyone with more rewards![/b]
- During the event period, you can earn double the rewards from Adventure Dungeons up to the daily limit.
- The double rewards event for Adventure Dungeons will run from after the 07/31 maintenance until 08/14 03:00 AM UTC /  08/13 08:00 PM PDT.

[b]* The Calydon’s Blessing event will be there to sate your hunger for Gold![/b]
- During the event period, your Calydon’s Hideout rewards will be doubled!
- The Calydon Blessing event will be held from after the maintenance on 07/31 until 08/14 03:00 AM UTC / 08/13 08:00 PM PDT.

[b]* Veda’s Nightmare deepens as the rewards for braving its halls increase, the “Blessing in Nightmare” event returns![/b]
- During the "Blessing in the Nightmare" event, you can earn double rewards from “Veda's Nightmare” and on “Nightmare of the Abyss” up to the daily limit. 
- The "Blessing in the Nightmare" event starts on 08/14 06:00 AM UTC / 08/13 11:00 PM PDT and will end before the regular maintenance on 08/28.

[b]* A new Reward Decree season will start.[/b]
- The new Reward Decree season will begin on 08/01 06:00 AM UTC / 07/31 11:00 PM PDT, and will run until 09/01 06:00 AM UTC / 08/30 11:00 PM PDT
- When you purchase Neejarem’s Reward Decree you will be able to obtain up to Ruby x2,280, Crystal of Fate x30, Solvent of Prayer x2, and much more!

[b]* A new season of Arena will begin.[/b]
- During this Arena Season, you can earn rewards such as Emotes and Insignia based on your progress.
- This Arena Season will end before the regular maintenance on 08/28.

[b]* A new season of Portrait of Thierry will be starting.[/b]
- After the maintenance, the attributes of the monsters on each floor of Portrait of Thierry will be changed.
- The new Portrait of Thierry season will end before the regular maintenance on 08/28.

[b]* A new season of Nightmare of the Abyss will be starting.[/b]
- With the new season, a new set of Abyss Trials will be applied to each stage.
 - The new Nightmare of the Abyss season will end before the regular maintenance on 08/28.

[b]* A new season of “Beast Battlefront” arrives.[/b]
- “Kurt, the Breath of Death” and his Enchanted Warriors breathe new life into this new Beast Battlefront season as the featured boss!
- "Beast Battlefront" content will be held twice during the season. The schedule is as follows:
　- 1st Round: 07/31 06:00 AM UTC / 07/30 11:00 PM PDT ~ 08/12
　　- Settlement until 08/14 06:00 AM UTC / 08/13 11:00 PM PDT
　- 2nd Round: 08/14 06:00 AM UTC / 08/13 11:00 PM PDT to 08/26
　　- Settlement until 08/28 06:00 AM UTC / 08/27 11:00 PM PDT


[h3][b]■ Store[/b][/h3]
[b]* A new Adventure Zone means new Packages![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/ec08062b94e4ef31650d5aff29380158cacc221b.png[/img]
- To commemorate the release of Trondheim, special packages will be available for purchase. These include:
  - Trondheim Celebrating Pack: Obtain Crystal of Destiny at a lower price!
  - Trondheim All Destiny Pack: Includes over 500 Crystal of Destiny plus some other goodies!
  - Trondheim Destiny & Fate Pack: Offers a large amount of Crystal of Destiny plus some Crystal of Fate too!
  - Trondheim Knight's Growth Pack: A Knight and Weapon Selection box plus the new “Virtuous Knight's Token,” which can raise your Knight’s level to 100 in a flash!
  - Trondheim Knight's Weapon Pack: A Knight and Weapon Selection box plus the new “Virtuous Weapon’s Token,” which can raise your Weapon’s level to 100 in a flash!


[b]* Virtuous Tokens[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/cb0cadcc4dfc7eb76802a2381cad71f1ca259791.png[/img]
- The Virtuous Knight’s Token and the Virtuous Weapon’s Token instantly raises the level of a Knight of Veda or weapon to Level 100.
- The Virtuous Knight’s Token upgrades any Knight of Veda below Lv.100 to Lv.100 and boosts their skills to Lv.10 while the Virtuous Weapon’s Token upgrades any weapon below Lv.100 to Lv.100.
- Any resources used on leveling or skill upgrades prior to the usage of these Tokens will be fully refunded.


[h3][b]■ Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
- An issue where the applied value and the displayed value for Goddess’s Armor was different will be fixed.
- An issue where the Progress and Reward Information for Portrait of Thierry - Glorious Age was incorrectly displayed will be fixed.
- An issue where the Challenge Success screen for Portrait of Thierry - Glorious Age was incorrectly displaying the time required to clear as “0” will be fixed.
- An issue where the increased level value for Graces on the Collection for Portrait of Thierry - Glorious Age was incorrectly displayed will be fixed.
- An issue where the weapons were not properly sorted by their rarity on the Call of the Stars result screen will be fixed.
- An issue where the ways to acquire “Splinter from the History,” an item used in Accessory Crafting, were not being displayed will be fixed.
- An issue where “Retribution” was not being applied when it should be on the first stage of Aurora’s Strong ATK will be fixed.
- An issue where Tenacity does not increase during Overflowing Power of the Stars will be fixed.
- An issue where an error pop-up would sometimes appear when selecting certain icons on Reward Decree will be fixed.
- An issue where the Electric Wound effect applied by Marthel was incorrectly applying an increase in Base DMG received instead of increasing the Electric DMG dealt will be fixed.
- An issue where the Mythical Skill of Xanthia was incorrectly capped to 50% will be fixed.
- An issue where Lucian’s “Sword of Light” would intermittently fail to fire when he casts his Normal Skill “Holy Sword of Blessing” after upgrading to Mythic will be fixed. (Updated on 07/29 08:56 AM UTC / 01:56 AM PDT)

We will continue to listen to your feedback to ensure an even more enjoyable adventure in ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

Thank you.

notes.title: Blessing in Nightmare (Double Rewards) Event Notice
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/8735016e997aab8afac4b100defe7bc12e71d113.png[/img]

Masters of the Book,

The endless nightmares feed the strength of Veda’s Chosen in the “Blessing in Nightmare” event! Clear stages on Veda’s Nightmare and earn double the rewards while the event is underway.

[h3][b]■ Event Period[/b][/h3]
* July 17, 2025 06:00 AM - July 31, 2025 before the maintenance (UTC)
* July 16, 2025 11:00 PM - July 31, 2025 before the maintenance (PDT)

[h3][b]■ Event Details & How to Participate[/b][/h3]
* Unlock after completing the world quest "Darkened Nightmare."
* Complete the Nightmare stages during the event period to earn double rewards.
* Use your Double Reward opportunity and Adventurer's Shoes to receive additional rewards.
* Double reward opportunities are limited to a maximum of four (4) times per day and reset daily at 06:00 AM (UTC) / 11:00 PM (PDT).

[h3][b]■ Notes[/b][/h3]
* The double rewards are limited to four (4) times daily, and the remaining entries can be found on the event page in-game. 
* Using Hero’s Shoes does not count for participating in this event. 
* Rewards received will be immediately delivered to your in-game inventory.
* For more detailed event precautions, refer to the [url=https://account.hybeim.com/en/policies/service/astra/event-policy][b]<Event Policy>[/b][/url].

Thank you.

notes.title: "Harold's Lost Knowledge" Event Notice
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/c1429c4aa34a09af4ef30f73883e8ea318d0ec21.png[/img]

Masters of the Book,

Harold urgently requests your help, as much research material is still needed for the ongoing study and documentation of the arcane.

Deliver the research materials to Harold and receive various abundant rewards.

[h3][b]■ Event Period[/b][/h3]
* July 17, 2025 06:00 AM - July 31, 2025 before the maintenance (UTC)
* July 16, 2025 11:00 PM - July 31, 2025 before the maintenance (PDT)

[h3][b]■ How to Participate[/b][/h3]
* You can participate after clearing Adventure Zone Stage 2-12 and completing the World Quest "Harold's Lost Knowledge."
* Within the "Guidance of the Book," you can access the event page for "Harold's Lost Knowledge" by selecting “Fast Travel” or by talking to the NPC Harold located in the central lobby of Todburg.
* A new quest and the required research materials will be revealed every day from the start of the event.
* After completing the Day 1 mission, you can check the conditions for unlocking the next mission via the “Research Journal” button.

[h3][b]■ Notes[/b][/h3]
* Rewards received will be immediately delivered to your in-game inventory.
* Rewards cannot be claimed after the event period ends, and any unclaimed rewards cannot be reissued.
* For more detailed event precautions, refer to the [url=https://account.hybeim.com/en/policies/service/astra/event-policy][b]<Event Policy>[/b][/url]

Assist Harold with his Journal and various riches await!

Thank you.

notes.title: Notice of Amendments to the DRIMAGE Privacy Policy
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/7da57300857a73b43a046c0205fd62c5424bf720.png[/img]

Masters of the Book,
