notes.title: 12/26 Patch Details (Updated on 12/26 9:40 AM UTC / 1:40 AM PST)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/9120f46e53b03b71dc0440b3f0c05cee4e8fd20f.jpg[/img]

Masters of the Book,

A new update to ASTRA: Knights of Veda will be released on December 26, 2024!

Read below to find out more about what this update will bring to the game.

[h3][b]■ From the flames, rise the newest 5★ Knight of Veda, Anais[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/eb2d59cfc0eb3986f02569b15e3ff048830dc36d.png[/img]
[b][b]"Now, I… want to help, together with Yor"[/b]

Lady Liongray, the companion of the eternal flame bird, has always remained true to her duty as a member of the Knights of Boden. As a knight, not as the youngest daughter of House Liongray, she endeavors to rescue those in need. With a compassionate heart yearning for peace, Anais will relentlessly work towards realizing her dreams[/b]


- “Anais” is a Fire-type Ranged Healer wielding a Wand & Orb. Anais is a healer who sacrifices a portion of her HP to boost ATK while simultaneously reviving vulnerable allies during her attacks. Her Normal Skill, "Radiant Flames of Life," allows the summoned Yor to unleash fireballs that pierce enemies and deal additional DMG when they explode. Her Signature Skill, "Wings of Eternal Flames," allows the summoned Yor to fly, dealing DMG to enemies in its path while granting a healing feather that heals allies.
- During the Pickup Hero Event, when a 5★ Knight of Veda or an Exclusive Weapon is summoned, the selected Hero or Weapon will appear with a 100% chance.

* In an endlessly deep abyss lies nightmares untold. The new “Nightmare of the Abyss” will be added to the game in this update
- ”Nightmare of the Abyss” is similar to “Veda’s Nightmare,” but features stronger enemies and the “Abyssal Trials” that will present a formidable obstacle to all Masters of the Book.
- ”Nightmare of the Abyss” can be unlocked after completing the World Quest, available after clearing Adventure Zone Chapter 9, Stage 12, and accessed through Veda’s Nightmare.
- You will be able to participate Solo or through Co-Op using either Normal, and Squad Battles.
- As shown on the image below, you will be able to see the unlocked “Nightmare of the Abyss” through the button shown.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/f0985a56c20782a4c20f966697b0f4f020506728.png[/img]
- In the “Nightmare of the Abyss,” monsters are more ferocious than those from the existing Veda’s Nightmare, and additional obstacles are introduced. The higher the Abyssal Level, the more powerful the enemies you will face and the more Abyssal Trials you will accumulate. But you’ll receive more rewards for that.
- The ”Nightmare of the Abyss,” has up to twenty (20) stages, with the available stages increasing or decreasing based on the results of the dungeon clears.
- When a “Nightmare of the Abyss” stage is cleared, a random Veda’s Nightmare stage will then be chosen to become an Abyss Nightmare.
- As a reward for clearing Nightmare of the Abyss, you can obtain the new equipment, ‘Goddess’s Armor.’ The higher the level you clear, the higher the grade of ‘Goddess’s Armor’ you can acquire.

* A new equipment type “Goddess’s Armor” will be added.
- “Goddess’s Armor” is a new equipment obtainable on the new “Nightmare Dungeon of the Deep Abyss.” By equipping this item, you will be able to enhance your Knights of Veda’s survivability. The “Goddess’s Armor” is classified according to different roles: Tank, DPS, Support, and Healer.
- The new equipment, ‘Goddess’s Armor,’ is available up to the legendary grade. Higher-grade ‘Goddess’s Armor’ can be obtained depending on the abyss level cleared in ‘Nightmare of the Deep.’
- You can equip “Goddess’s Armor” on the Equipment Tab.
- Achievements related to “Goddess’s Armor” have also been added to the game.

* “Pickup All-Out” returns, this time for good. Check out the new “Guided by the Stars” and “Weapons Awakened Under the Stars” Call of the Stars.
- On the new “Guided by the Stars” Call of the Stars, you will be able to summon Season 1 5★ Pickup Knights of Veda while on the “Weapons Awakened Under the Stars” Call of the Stars, you will be able to summon their respective Exclusive Weapons.
- The new Call of the Stars also include the Knight of Veda “Rhynara” and her Exclusive Weapon.
- The “Grace of the Holy Grail” count for these new Call of the Stars is separate from those of the Pickup Hero Event and the Fallen Wing of Veda Call of the Stars.
- Each new Call of the Stars also offer bonus rewards based on the number of summons made on them, allowing you to choose and guarantee the Season 1 5★ Pickup Knight of Veda or Exclusive Weapon of your choice.
- The Pickup All-Out Event also applies to the ‘Mark of the Sworn Loyalty’ and ‘Fragments of the Painting’ events, with all Season 1 Pickup Knights of Veda and Rynara’s Halo/El Cid included.
- The number of attempts made in the previous "Aslan's Pickup Hero Event" and "Pickup Exclusive Weapon Event" has been retroactively applied to the 'Call of the Stars Count' progress of 'Guided by the Stars' and 'Weapons Awakened Under the Stars'. (Updated 12/26 9:40 AM UTC / 1:40 AM PST)​​​​​​​
 
* Improvements arrive to Portrait of Thierry this update!
- The “Sweep” feature will now also be available to Portrait of Thierry.
- At the start of a new season of Portrait of Thierry, you can select a floor range where the sweep will be applied up to the last cleared floor.
- During the sweep, all clear rewards, including Accessories, will be given.
- The “Portrait of Boden Caryen” has been improved to not only revive the selected Knights of Veda but also fully heal their wounds.
- On Floors 28 to 36 of Portrait of Thierry, the drop rate for Mythic Accessories has been increased from 10% to 15%.
- The reward for clearing Floor 36, the Legendary Set Accessory Ticket previously given as clear reward will be replaced by a Mythical Set Accessory Ticket.

* The Sweep feature will also be added to the Ancient Golden City.
- You can now perform a Sweep on Ancient Golden City stages that you have previously cleared.
- Stages cleared using Support Knights of Veda will not be Sweepable.

* We've added a new map to Arena Survival: “Faded Last Land.” 
- Players will be randomly assigned to play on the existing map, “Estate of the Fallen Loser,” or the new map, “Faded Last Land.”

* A ‘Show Recommended Relics’ function will be added to guide players in selecting the most suitable Relics for each Knights of Veda.
- This new feature can be accessed by clicking the newly added icon on a currently equipped Relic.
- When you click the “Show Recommended Relics” button, a Relic that will suit the selected Knight of Veda will be displayed. By using Filters, you can sort and easily view the desired Relic with your preferred stats for easy equipping.

* We're adding the “Craft & Shop” feature to the Adventure Guide!
- You can access your desired features, such as Crafting or Enchanting, easily through the Adventure Guide without checking the map!

* Charging up your Adventurer’s Shoes will be improved.
- When charging your Adventurer’s Shoes with Rubies or Starstones, you will now be able to do so up to ten (10) times at once.
- The number of “Steps of the Journey” you can use at once has been increased from five (5) to ninety-nine (99).
- The maximum number of Adventurer’s Shoes you can obtain has been increased from 999 to 9,999.

* Missed a day? Use the “Make-up Attendance” feature to catch up on any rewards you might have missed.
- The "Make-up Attendance" function calculates the maximum number of days available from the start of the event to the current day, enabling you to claim missed rewards.
- The cost will be Starstone x160 per day of attendance.

* The purchase limit for Common-grade ingredients in the Cooking Store has been changed from unlimited to 200 items.

* The information window for the Arena Store has been improved so that it will now display the stats of Tunic.

* To celebrate the arrival of the new year, the “The Sun Rises Again" will be held.
- During “The Sun Rises Again" event you will be able to earn the new mascot “Bacon” by logging in for seven (7) days during the event period.
- “The Sun Rises Again" event will end after the regular maintenance on 1/9.

* In addition, the “New Year Mission” event will also be held.
- The “New Year Mission” event will end after the regular maintenance on 1/23

* Shattered Dimensional Rift event
- Earn Guild Kill rewards and Individual Kill rewards based on the number of Rogue One defeated with your guild members. Guild Defeat rewards include Insignias in addition to other rewards.
- The "Shattered Dimensional Rift" event will end on 1/16.

* A Double Rewards event for Adventure Zone rewards will be held.
- During the event period, you can earn double the rewards from Adventure Zone up to the daily limit.
- The double rewards event for Adventure Zone will end after the regular maintenance on 1/9.

* A new season of Portrait of Thierry will be starting.
 - After the maintenance, the attributes of the monsters on each floor of Portrait of Thierry will be changed.
 - The new Portrait of Thierry season will end after the regular maintenance on 1/23.

* A new season of Arena will begin.
- During Arena Season 7, you can earn rewards such as Emotes and Insignia based on your progress.
- The Season 4 Tunic rewards will also be available for purchase in the shop during Arena Season 7.
- Arena Season 7 will end after the regular maintenance on 1/23.

* A new season of “Beast Battlefront” arrives.
- For this season, the Poison-attribute “Swamp King Maneater” will be gracing us with their presence as the featured boss.
- "Beast Battlefront" content will be held twice during the season. The schedule is as follows:
  - 1st Round: 12/26 to 1/7 / Settlement: 1/7 to 1/9 
  - 2nd Round: 1/9 to 1/21 / Settlement: 1/21 to 1/23

* A new Reward Decree season will start.
- The new Reward Decree season will begin right after January 1, 2025, and will run until January 31, 2025 6:00 AM UTC / January 30, 2025 10:00 PM PST.

* The "Journey in Memory (Anais Trial)" event will be held.
- During this Trial event, you can try out Knights of Veda: 5★ Anais, 4★ Iris, and 4★ Bjorn.
- The "Journey in Memory (Anais Trial)" event will end after the regular  maintenance on 1/23.

* The “Fateful Encounter” encounter event will be held.
- Log-in for seven (7) days to earn various bountiful rewards.
- The "Fateful Encounter" event will start on ½ and will end after the regular maintenance on 1/23.

[h3][b]■ Improvements[/b][/h3]
 * The difficulty level for the “Path of Trials” and “Path of Succession” difficulties of the Ancient Golden City will be reduced.
 * The difficulty levels for “Portrait of Thierry” Floors below 25 will be lowered.
 * The AI of unfocused Veda Knights will be improved for more efficient movement during Squad Battle.
 * The health bonus given to Masters of the Book on PVP battles will be adjusted to reduce the chances of battles ending abruptly.

[h3][b]■ Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
* An issue where the Stamina-based additional damage from Aslan’s Signature Skill ”Deadly Leap and Blow” was not applied when switching to another character after the shockwave was triggered will be resolved.

We will continue to listen to your feedback to ensure an even more enjoyable adventure in ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

Thank you.

notes.title: Summary of the Director’s Live Broadcast and Q&A
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/9537912f26b3d97de9f44fe9e1c7a78a12fc1b72.png[/img]

Masters of the Book,
I am Kim Young-mo, the director of ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

We have recently conducted a Live Broadcast where we were able to have an honest conversation with our Korean Masters of the Book. Unfortunately, due to circumstances, I was unable to meet and address you, our Global Masters of the Book, who have always shown their unwavering love. I would like to express my deepest apologies for this.

Due to this, we would also like to share with our Global Users the content revealed and the questions answered during the broadcast, even if it’s in writing.


Through this live broadcast, the development team had the valuable opportunity to hear various opinions that we had not considered before. As the Director, I cannot make all the decisions on my own, so we’ve arranged to review and discuss the points you shared with the development team.

We will provide clear responses on what can be answered and give specific details regarding the update schedule.

[h3][b]ASTRA: Knights of Veda Update Roadmap[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/3a6d460a147c61a18e53938d22c8d69124a182c3.png[/img]

[h3][b]Director’s Live Broadcast Q&A[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]Call of the Stars[/b][/h3]
[b]Q:[/b] Since the 11/28 update, the Pickup All-Out event has disappeared. Does this mean that the event will never come back?
[b]A:[/b] Starting from the 12/26 update, the Pickup All-Out event will now be available permanently and in addition, will include Rhynara. This means all of the previously released characters can now be summoned once again.

[b]Q:[/b] The Aslan Pickup Hero Event doesn’t take advantage of the Pick-Up Draw system. Does this mean future Knights of Veda releases will also exclude the feature? If so, will there be any compensation for users who paid to take advantage of it?
[b]A:[/b] As stated, the Pickup All-Out event that will be made permanent (and now also includes Rhynara) will feature the “Pick-Up Draw” system. Additionally, the bonus system, where you can obtain a Knight of Veda from the permanent Pick-Up event after 300 summons, will also return.

[b]Q:[/b] Are there any plans to add Knights of Veda to the “Fallen Wing of Veda” Call of the Stars?
[b]A:[/b] Adding Knights of Veda to the permanent “Fallen Wing of Veda” Call of the Stars may make them more difficult to obtain. For now, we plan to retain the current roster of Knights available in “Fallen Wing of Veda.” However, we aim to make Season 1 Pickup Knights of Veda easier to acquire and introduce increased rates in “Fallen Wing of Veda.” More details will be shared once finalized.

[b]Q:[/b] Since the “Pickup All-Out” event will be made permanent, does this also mean the corresponding Halo and El Cid events will come back and be made permanent?
[b]A:[/b] That is correct. Both the Halo and El Cid events will come back.

[b]Q:[/b] Are there any plans to buff the Exclusive Weapons that can be obtained from “Fallen Wing of Veda?”
[b]A:[/b] We do have plans to buff the permanent Exclusive Weapons. However, there may be users who are dissatisfied with the improvements made versus the original stats. Therefore, we are preparing a system that allows players to choose between the original and new stats. We will share more details and the update schedule once it's finalized.

[h3][b]Knights of Veda[/b][/h3]
[b]Q:[/b] For Fire-attribute Knights, it’s only Edward that fills the DPS role. Anais is being introduced as another Fire-attribute Knight but she’s in the Healer role and that’s disappointing. Are there any plans to remedy this?
[b]A:[/b] Although Anais is a healer, she is also a great damage dealer. She has a unique "Wound Healing" ability that other Healers don't have, allowing her to keep the party alive in content like the Celestial Trials, where the difficulty increases fast.

[b]Q:[/b] Bikki’s performance is overwhelming in all content, and I am concerned about balance. Are there any plans for adjustments?
[b]A:[/b] There are currently no plans to nerf Bikki. However, we plan to add other Knights of Veda who can provide buffs and perform on the same level as Bikki does in different content. Our goal is to ensure that all Knights are useful in various content, so we ask for your patience as we continue to improve the game.

[b]Q:[/b] Can you tell us about any 4★ Knights of Veda that we can look forward to in Legendary Promotion?
[b]A:[/b] While all 4★ Knights of Veda will get improved in one way or the other, we would like our Masters of the Book to take a closer look at Leon, Yanko, Rani, and Orlik, all of whom have significant roles in the story. We also have plans to buff some  5★ Knights of Veda, ensuring that all of them are viable and useful across the game.

[b]Q:[/b] Aurora’s Fate Level 7 effect doesn’t expand the range but only does direct damage. Is there a plan to improve this?
[b]A:[/b] We are aware of this issue and are planning to make improvements. Not only for Aurora but for all underperforming knights, we are considering overall buffs.

[b]Q:[/b] Will there be any plans to release more Dual-Attribute Knights of Veda
[b]A:[/b] For the 1st Anniversary update, we plan to release "White Hell," the first Dual-Attribute dealer with Lightning and Light attributes.

[b]Q:[/b] Aslan has a high fixed damage output. Are there any plans to release a character that can counter this?
[b]A:[/b] The fixed damage cap is not particularly high, and as stats increase, Aslan’s value will naturally decrease. We plan to consider buffs when the time comes.

[b]Q:[/b] There seems to be an issue with Aslan’s stamina.
[b]A:[/b] We’ve identified an error where Stamina-based additional damage from Aslan’s Signature Skill ”Deadly Leap and Blow” was not applied when switching to another character after the shockwave was triggered. This issue does not occur in Squad Battles, and we plan to fix it in the 12/26 update.

[b]Q:[/b] Are there plans to release a non-elemental Knights of Veda?
[b]A:[/b] Non-elemental characters would likely become all-purpose characters, so we currently do not plan to release one.

[b]Q:[/b] I’m curious why the focused Knight deals more damage during Training Ground Squad Battles.
[b]A:[/b] The difference in damage comes from the AI used by the focused Knight compared to the other Knights in the party. The focused Knight uses a standard AI, while the others use the Bot AI, which is the same AI used in Arena, which has a delay when using skills to ensure an appropriate level of difficulty is maintained. This delay is the cause of the difference in damage output. However, in the 12/26 Update, we have adjusted this so that the AI used in the Training Grounds will now be the same for all Knights, eliminating any discrepancies in damage.

[h3][b]Content[/b][/h3]
[b]Q:[/b] Are there any plans to introduce multiplayer content such as Guild Wars and Co-Op Boss Battles?
[b]A:[/b] With the 12/26 Update, we will be introducing a new content called “Nightmare of the Abyss.” While this content can be cleared solo, it includes mechanics that encourage users to party with other users to lower the difficulty.

[b]Q:[/b] As F2P users tend to grind and farm for resources more, they tend to feel like chores after a certain period. To remedy this, I feel like more RPG elements being added to the game would be great.
[b]A:[/b] We have been preparing and carefully considering new content. We hope that the "Nightmare of the Abyss" content, which will be introduced in the 12/26 Update, will quench this thirst for new content.

[b]Q:[/b] The Celestial Trials gamemode is too difficult.
[b]A:[/b] Celestial Trials Floors were designed to avoid feeling repetitive. However, for content like the Celestial Trials and Portrait of Thierry, we plan to adjust the difficulty of the early floors each time new ones are added. 

[b]Q:[/b] Portrait of Thierry’s playtime is too long, and the difficulty for Floors 30 and above are too high, are there any plans to adjust these? 
[b]A:[/b] In an update that will be released in January, we plan to expand the number of floors and adjust the difficulty. In addition, by equipping the new "Goddess's Armor," which can be obtained from the new "Nightmare of the Abyss" content, you can improve your survivability and make it easier to clear Floors. We also plan to lower the difficulty of the lower floors in the 12/26 update to allow more players to clear it.

[b]Q:[/b] The drop rate of Mythic Accessories on Portrait of Thierry seems to be very low.
[b]A:[/b] In the 12/26 Update, the drop rate for Mythic Accessories will be increased from 10% to 15%. Additionally, we will be adding a sweep function to Portrait of Thierry, making it easier to obtain Mythic Accessories.

[b]Q:[/b] Nec and Orlik have been dominating Battlefield of the War Gods for some time now. Are there any plans to address this?
[b]A:[/b] Since there are players who have invested in growing Nec and Orlik specifically for the "Battlefield of the War Gods" content, we do not plan to make immediate changes. As with how various metas have changed in that content, we expect a new meta to emerge that will supersede the current one in the future. Instead of artificially controlling the current meta, we aim to create new metas where different character combinations can overcome the current one.

[h3][b]Items[/b][/h3]
[b]Q:[/b] There are too many currencies which increases the barrier to entry. Are there any plans to add new progression systems, and thus currency?
[b]A:[/b] We acknowledge that the amount of currency required for improving your Knights of Veda can feel frustrating, and to alleviate this, we are introducing the "Sweep System" for each piece of content to reduce the difficulty of acquiring resources for enhancement. Although this is not part of the roadmap yet, we are preparing a system that will automatically repeat and progress dungeons, and we aim to let you know about it before the first anniversary of the game.

[b]Q:[/b] I’m running out of Adventurer’s Shoes and would like to see more sources for Gold and Starstones.
[b]A:[/b] We are continuously increasing the rewards given through events, but we understand that it may still feel insufficient for active players. We are monitoring this situation and will keep making improvements to ensure players can enjoy all of the content without inconvenience. 

However, regarding Adventurer’s Shoes, increasing their acquisition quantity could impact overall playtime and character growth, so we ask for your understanding as we must carefully consider any changes related to this system.

[b]Q:[/b] “Solvent of Prayer” is too expensive.
[b]A:[/b] Relics are a core part of the game and are an integral piece of beating the highest-level content, so changing an option on a relic holds significant value. Given that there are players who have already purchased these items, it's difficult to reduce the price immediately. However, we are considering ways to improve the situation and will explore potential solutions.

[h3][b]System[/b][/h3]
[b]Q:[/b] I would like a feature where I can choose to keep the old stats when Enchanting an item.
[b]A:[/b] Thank you for your suggestion. We will be implementing this feature, using a system similar to the Relic Bloom system in the 1/23 Update.

[h3][b]Others[/b][/h3]
[b]Q:[/b] How often will new maps and additions to the main story be released?
[b]A:[/b] The Main Story for Season 2 will be expanded after approximately three more updates. The storyline and overall content have already been decided, and we are currently working on finalizing it. Rest assured that we will bring more exciting story updates to you, just as you expect.

[b]Q:[/b] The time between updates feels too long, and the announcements are made too close to the release of said content.
[b]A:[/b] Since we operate globally, preparing official announcements may take a significant amount of time. As a result, it’s difficult to expedite this process. However, we plan to improve communication by using all available official channels to provide more frequent updates.

[b]Q:[/b] I miss the darker tone of Season 1’s Art Style, are there any plans to return to or improve upon it?
[b]A:[/b] We are doing our best to match the art style from Season 1 and are working hard to bring the original aesthetic back. However, instead of reworking already released characters, we plan to address this through costumes or skins.

[b]Q:[/b] Are there any plans to add a feature to replay the story segments or at the very least upload them to YouTube for future viewing?
[b]A:[/b] There is already a system in the game that allows you to rewatch story cutscenes via the Journal or the Collection menu. However, we realize that cutscenes alone may not fully convey the story, so we are considering other ways to release the entire story for easier access.

[b]Q:[/b] Are there any plans for collaborations?
[b]A:[/b] We are currently considering collaborations with titles that align well with ASTRA: Knights of Veda’s theme and aesthetic. Our focus is not just on popular titles, but rather on ones that can generate synergy with the game and bring new experiences to our players. We apologize for not being able to announce collaborations in advance, but rest assured that once details are finalized, we will inform you as soon as possible.

[b]Q:[/b] As updates continue, I feel the game’s performance is worsening and that optimization is not being done. Will there be plans to improve this?
[b]A:[/b] We continuously strive to improve optimization with every update, but it’s a challenging process. We are dedicated to creating an environment where players can enjoy the game with smooth and stable gameplay. We hope for your patience as we work towards this goal.

[b]Q:[/b] The rewards for Synchronizing with your Knights of Veda feel too low. I hope this will be improved.
[b]A:[/b] We recognize the importance of rewards for reaching higher Sync levels. We agree that the rewards have not been sufficient compared to the difficulty of reaching those levels. Therefore, in the 1/23 Update, we plan to improve this by offering "Crystals of Fate" as rewards for certain Synchronization levels.

[b]Q:[/b] How can I purchase the Tunic again?
[b]A:[/b] Tunics from previous seasons are available for sale through the Arena Shop. However, to maintain fairness for players who earned the Tunic through active participation in the Arena, it is only sold after three (3) seasons have passed.

We hope that the answers provided are satisfactory to all of our Masters of the Book. In addition to the official announcement notices, we will also be engaging more with the community to address all of your feedback.

We will continue to listen and strive to make the game more enjoyable for everyone.

Thank you.

notes.title: “A Gift in the Middle of the Night” Event Guide
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/4f6e64a07d8e5c1b5f7b3786cf4193d33eefb9e6.png[/img]

Masters of the Book,

The holiday spirit has settled upon the continent of Planis, energizing everyone into a festive mood.

notes.title: The Second Season 2 Developer Interview
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/6bd9b75f1074a18b582587b4593e5d9ec661eacc.jpg[/img]
 
Masters of the Book,
 
Are you enjoying Season 2 of ASTRA: Knights of Veda?
 
We would like to express once again our sincerest gratitude for all our Masters of the Book who joined us at our various events and shared their gameplay experience. 
 
In the previous Developer Interview, we shared stories from some members of our Development Team for the first time. Through their stories, we were able to let you get a sneak peak into the setting design team and character concept art team’s work processes, letting our Masters of the Book have a look at how the fascinating characters and world of ASTRA: Knights of Veda are created. 
 
Thank you very much for reading their stories! We’ll be sharing more of our developers' stories so that you’ll feel closer to the team.
 
In the 11/28 update, the new Knight of Veda “Aslan” and one of the major contents of Season 2, Celestial Trials, has been introduced. Celestial Trials, is a new end-game PvE content that is the continuation of the previous Tower of Trials content, offering a fun challenge to Masters of the Book.
 
In this interview, we will be joined by S from the Content Design Team, who planned this exciting content, to talk about how the Celestial Trials was designed, and the challenges faced during the design process and other interesting stories.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/f540cb6d6c82496d5d2d439b4245ca16100d1ee2.png[/img] 
[h3][b]Q. Hello, Please introduce yourself.[/b][/h3]
[b]S :[/b]
That’s correct, we do keep these story beats in mind when thinking of Knights to include in the game. The various Knights of Veda all have different tasks and objectives while the Master of the Book was adventuring to Gigantfall in Season 1. However, as the Master of the Book continues to grow in power and fame, their fates eventually become entangled as their objectives intersect with those of the Master of the Book. 
 
[h3][b]Q. What was the most important aspect your team was considering when planning “Celestial Trials”?[/b][/h3]
[b]S : [/b]
To put it simply, it would be “strategic combat”.
 
In Celestial Trials, each floor has its own unique and special rules, which means players will face new challenges every time they ascend the tower.
 
For example, on some floors, the abilities of certain Knights of Veda may be either enhanced or restricted, and on others, enemies with special abilities may appear. 
 
We considered many aspects to ensure that players can experience a sense of achievement and fun strategizing around the limits and enhancements attached to each floor. We are also striving to provide fair rewards for everyone and for each floor cleared.
 
As Celestial Trials was not designed to be competitive content, but rather a challenge-based content for each Master of the Book, we hope that everyone can enjoy the content at their own pace.
 
[h3][b]Q. As Celestial Trials is replacing Tower of Trials, we’re curious if there were any elements intended to differentiate them from each other. [/b][/h3]
[b]S : [/b]
Tower of Trials was initially designed with the same goals as what we set out to achieve with Celestial Trials, to offer the enjoyment of challenge and achievement. However, as more new content gets added to the game, the content has become more of a busy work you need to do every reset, a repetitive task
 
To address this issue, Celestial Trials was designed to offer an experience that is not simply repetitive gameplay, but one where players must face and overcome each floor by strategizing and utilizing their Knights to their fullest potential
 
We hope that players will create new strategies for each floor, immersing themselves and enjoying the experience even more.
 
[h3][b]Q. Celestial Trials feature an infinite number of floors. Were there any considerations to prevent players from feeling bored as they continue to challenge these endless floors?[/b][/h3]
[b]S : [/b]
To follow up on my previous answer, we made efforts to incorporate as many different strategies and approaches to a floor as possible.
 
We carefully thought about and aimed to increase the overall strategic depth by thinking about how to effectively use the skills and combinations of each Knight of Veda in various combat situations. We also made sure that we are not only giving the commonly used Knights, but also those with lower usage, new roles and strategic uses.
 
Additionally, I believe that when players successfully clear a difficult challenge, they should be rewarded accordingly. For example, Masters of the Book who clear a specific floor for the first time will be recorded as the "First Conqueror" of that floor, and all users will receive rewards linked to this achievement. We’ve also prepared new and special items as part of the rewards, so I hope players will enjoy them.
 
[h3][b]Q. This question is unrelated to Celestial Trials. ASTRA: Knights of Veda features a variety of PvE and PvP content. What content did you personally enjoy playing the most?[/b][/h3]
[b]S : [/b]
Recently, I’ve been enjoying Beast Battlefront. When it was first added, I only got to play it for a week, and I remember feeling quite disappointed. However, now that the event duration has been extended and there are more types of buffs and debuffs, I find it increasingly fun.
 
Personally, I think the biggest appeal of Beast Battlefront is that the strategies you use can change depending on the bosses, buffs, and debuffs that appear. Although it’s not PvP, the fact that you can compete with other players adds to the excitement. The competitive aspect definitely makes the experience more immersive and challenging. This makes it so that if I’m asked to name a favorite content, Beast Battlefront will definitely be one of the top choices for me.
 
[h3][b]Q. Finally, after the Season 2 update, many new contents will be added and revamped. Could you give us any hints about the major upcoming content?[/b][/h3]
[b]S : [/b]
We are developing content designed to stimulate players’ sense of challenge and make the game even more enjoyable. For example, we are working on a very difficult dungeon where players can team up and use various strategies or party play to tackle it, as well as content where players can challenge gigantic, powerful bosses and compete with other players.
 
I hope players continue to show interest not only in the existing content but also in the upcoming updates.
 
 
 
Where do you usually check for information and updates about ASTRA: Knights of Veda
 
Since the opening of the Official Discord Server, various information can be found there, but the place to go where you can find all information about the game has always been the official website.
 
Did you know that we have revamped the Official Website with the Season 2 update? It now offers a more intuitive interface and richer information.
 
To learn more about the updated website, we’ll be talking with UI Design Team’s Deputy Team Leader, “Ribbit”
 
[h3][b]Q. Hello, Please introduce yourself.[/b][/h3]
[b]Deputy Team Leader Ribbit : [/b]
Hello, Masters of the Book, it’s nice to finally be able to meet all of you. I’m Ribbit, the Deputy Team Leader for the UI Design Team, responsible for game UI and marketing design.
 
[h3][b]Q. You have participated in the design of the Official Website from its early stages. 
We think it captures the game’s Dark Fantasy vibe through the dark-toned background and vibrant illustrations. What was the most important element considered during the initial planning phase of the website’s design to visually convey this vibe?[/b][/h3]
[b]Deputy Team Leader Ribbit : [/b]
When we were planning the Official Website for ASTRA: Knights of Veda, the main concern was, “What do the players, the Masters of the Book, want to see on the Official Website?”
 
I wanted to ensure that all of the information from the game could be viewed in one place while also allowing the players to be immersed in the game’s world and setting.
 
From a design perspective, the artwork we use in ASTRA: Knights of Veda is of a very high quality with very detailed textures. I felt it was a shame to only be able to view the artwork on such a small canvas, so I wanted to showcase the art by making use of larger image sizes.
 
However, this same detail and density in the artwork also makes it so that we use simple shapes like points, lines, and surfaces for the website’s other design elements to maintain a sense of balance. Overly simplified designs will look unfinished however if they are used right beside the highly-detailed art so we focused on finding the right balance between them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/93b7c2f8aa35dd5d65e8aea96902aa8fdfa30ae6.png[/img] 
[h3][b]Q. With the Season 2 Update, the website was also overhauled. What was the main goal of this overhaul? Are there any parts that you would like our Masters of the Book to pay special attention to?[/b][/h3]
[b]Deputy Team Leader Ribbit : [/b]
Season 2 was the first big update we did since the launch of ASTRA: Knights of Veda, and a lot of new stuff was introduced, from a new story and new characters to additional Relics and a variety of new Monsters.
 
In line with this, we updated and overhauled the website and added this information to the guides available on the website.
 
By doing this, we hope to help experienced Masters of the Book immerse themselves more in the world of ASTRA: Knights of Veda. For example, some Knights of Veda, formerly listed under [Etc.] are now categorized under their respective factions to clarify their relationships with other Knights of Veda and their factions. Additionally, [Noah’s Map] was updated with the new Adventure Zones alongside the new ones.
 
I hope that with this, players can conveniently view the information they missed in the game, presented in detail and in a visual form.
 
[h3][b]Q. Do you personally play ASTRA: Knights of Veda? If so, were there any aspects of your gameplay experience that helped with designing the website?[/b][/h3]
[b]Deputy Team Leader Ribbit : [/b]
Yes! I play the game quite a lot. In fact, while designing the character introduction pages, the information I learned about each character’s elements, exclusive weapons, skills, and so on turned out to be quite helpful when playing the game.
 
[h3][b]Q. Apart from the new features and design elements added during the overhaul coinciding with Season 2’s release, are there any functions you would like added or areas you wish you’d improve in the future?[/b][/h3]
[b]Deputy Team Leader Ribbit : [/b]
I’m not sure if our Masters of the Book remember, but in the teaser site revealed during the FGT, we had animated character motion art for the 5★ Knights. After the launch of the game, and the subsequent redesign of the Official Website, we had to remove those animated character art for various reasons, and only the static illustration is displayed. I do feel a bit of regret about that and wish that we’ll be able to display ASTRA’s beautiful art in animated form.
 
Additionally, if possible, I’m considering if it’s possible to improve the official website, such as introducing a daily-updated ranking table showcasing users' combat and attack power.
 
[h3][b]Q. Finally, as its designer, do you wish to share a message with the Master of the Books visiting the game’s official website?[/b][/h3]
[b]Deputy  Team Leader Ribbit : [/b]
First of all, I and the team would like to thank you for the love and support you give ASTRA: Knights of Veda and to our work on the official website.
 
I hope that the website becomes a place where everyone who loves the game and its world can discover more about the game and the people who inhabit it. 
 
We would be grateful if you continue your support for ASTRA: Knights of Veda into the future. Thank you very much!
 
 
 
In today’s interviews, we had the opportunity to hear the behind-the-scenes stories of ASTRA: Knight of Veda’s development team, from both the game designer of the “Celestial Trials” game mode and the designer of the game’s Official Website. In it we learned how the game has continuously evolved and has been shaped by you, our Masters of the Book.
 
Celestial Trials offers players new challenges and a deeper, more strategic combat experience that is also constantly being refined. While, thanks to the efforts of our designer, the Season 2 Website overhaul introduces a more intuitive and engaging design, making it easier for Masters of the Book to access game information and lore.
 
We sincerely thank all Masters of the Book for their love and support for ASTRA: Knights of Veda. Your valuable feedback and continuous interest are a great source of strength to all in the development team. We look forward to bringing more exciting and enjoyable content to meet your expectations.
 
Thank you.

notes.title: 11/28 Patch Detail (Updated 12/2 3:09 AM UTC / 12/1 7:09 PM PDT)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/9120f46e53b03b71dc0440b3f0c05cee4e8fd20f.jpg[/img]

Masters of the Book!

A new update to ASTRA: Knights of Veda will be released on November 28, 2024!

Read below to find out more about what this update will bring to the game.

[h3][b]■ A new 5★ Knight of Veda “Aslan” will now be available![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/238ce1cbf4029950474583e425c1a0ff377bb91c.png[/img]

[h3][b]“The King demands victory”[/b][/h3]

[i][b]"Aslan Liongray, who chose to pledge his allegiance to the king instead.
He gave everything for his family, but House Liongray gave him nothing in return. The stigma of being "unchosen" ate away at his heart, and on the day he faced the blade of betrayal, Aslan chose the king instead"[/b][/i]


- “Aslan” is an Earth-type Melee DPS who uses a Sword & Shield. He converts his Stamina into Skill DMG to deal powerful DMG and uses his skills to take the initiative in battle. Aslan's Normal Skill, “Iron Rock Wall,” is his primary CC ability, causing rocks to pile up high in front of him, dealing DMG to enemies within range and incapacitating them for a period of time, leaving them vulnerable to follow-up attacks. His Signature Skill, “Deadly Leap and Blow,” is an offensive skill that allows him to leap to an enemy's location and deliver a powerful blow that knocks them into the air, leaving them defenseless and vulnerable to further attacks
- Starting this update, summoning in a Pickup Hero or Pickup Exclusive Weapon Event guarantees a 100% appearance rate for the featured 5★ Knight of Veda or Exclusive Weapon.

*  Endless conquest to reach the top floor, with the new content “Celestial Trials”.
 - The new content, ‘Celestial Trials,’ challenges players to conquer a tower one floor at a time, advancing to greater heights. Each floor features powers that either strengthen or weaken the Knights of Veda, requiring strategic planning and careful team building to overcome.
 - To access “Celestial Trials”, you must clear Chapter 7 Stage 12 of the Adventure Zone, after which the World Quest “Celestial Trials” will be available. (Players who already have access to the Tower of Trials will not need to do this quest and can enter immediately.)
 - The mechanics and combat systems for “Celestial Trials” are the same as the previous “Tower of Trials”, only with the addition of each floor having special rules, buffs, and debuffs. Battles will also be fought in various dungeon types.
 - There will be an initial clear reward for every floor, and with every initial clear of ten floors, a “First Conqueror” reward will be given to all users, given under the name of the Master of the Book who cleared it first.
 - When someone becomes the “First Conqueror”, a notification with that player’s name will be sent to all Masters of the Book.
 - First clearing the 30th and 50th floors of ‘Celestial Trials’ grants the ‘Mark of Glorious Response’, a reward that can be used to customize with the new ‘Mark of Sanctity’ feature.
 - You can view the rankings to check the status of users who participated in ‘Celestial Trials’.

* A new way to decorate your equipped Halo, “Mark of Sanctity”, will be added to the game.
 - The “Mark of Sanctity” is an item that will allow you to change the appearance of your equipped Halo.
 - No additional game effects are given when equipping the “Mark of Sanctity” and are purely cosmetic.
 - You can obtain this item as a first clear reward from the “Celestial Trials” content.

* Randomly change one of your Relic’s sub-stats with the new “Blooming Relics” feature.
 - “Blooming Relics” feature can be accessed via the newly added “Blooming” button.
 - Select the Relic you want to modify and the sub-stat you want to change, then press the "Bloom" button. The selected sub-stat will be changed into a random stat selected from a pool of sub-stats of the same tier as your Relic.
 - You will be able to do “Blooming Relics” with the new “Solvent of Prayer”, which can be obtained as First Clear Reward for the new “Celestial Trials” content and by purchasing it with Gold or Rubies in the Shop.

* A new difficulty level will be added to the “Ancient Golden City”
 - “Path of the Dynast II”, a new difficulty level, will be added to the Ancient Golden City with this update.
 - Under this new difficulty level, you will be able to obtain more rewards.

* Starting this update, summoning in a Pickup Hero or Pickup Exclusive Weapon Event guarantees a 100% appearance rate for the featured 5★ Knight of Veda or Exclusive Weapon.

* To celebrate the end of one year and the coming of another, we will conduct a special login event called “December's Special Rewards”.
 - As a token of our appreciation, the “December's Special Rewards” login event will allow our Masters of the Book to obtain a “Knight of Veda & Weapon Selection Box” on the 7th and 28th day of logging in.
 - Upon using the “Knight of Veda & Weapon Selection Box” you will be given either a Standard 5★ Knight of Veda and Weapon or a Pickup 5★ Knight of Veda and Exclusive Weapon (excluding the new Knight of Veda, Aslan)
 - The “December's Special Rewards” event will be held from after the 11/28 Maintenance until December 31, 2024.

* To celebrate the upcoming Holidays, the “Winter Morning Bells” event will be held where you can clear missions and earn rewards.
 - The “Winter Morning Bells” event will end after the regular maintenance on 12/26.

* Join the ‘Simon’s Amazing Gifts’ event! Work together with your Guild members to defeat treasure chests and claim exciting rewards.
 - The “Simon’s Amazing Gifts” event can be participated in every Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday at 8:00 PM during the event period, at the Guild Territory.
 - With this update, a new feature will be added that allows you to check and choose whether to receive the contents of the first Treasure Chest you select after defeating the Fearsome Treasure Chest.
 - Various rewards can be obtained from this event, and for this current iteration: the new mascot “Ted Fatale” can be earned.
 - “Simon’s Amazing Gifts” will run from December 5, 2024 until December 22, 2024.

* The "Special Supply Delivery Operation" event will be held once again.
 - Each stage consists of 3 rounds, and you can acquire buffs upon entry and after completing the 1st and 2nd rounds of combat.
 - If you successfully complete the supply transport, you will receive rewards.
 - The "Special Supply Delivery Operation" event will end after the maintenance on 12/26.

*  The “Distorted Rift” appears once again on Todburg and will run until December 12, 2024.

* The "Blessing in Adventure" event is back to shower everyone with more rewards!
 - During the event period, you can earn double the rewards from Adventure Dungeons up to the daily limit.
 - The double rewards event for Adventure Dungeons will run from November 28 after maintenance until December 12, 2024 05:59 AM UTC / December 11, 2024 09:59 PM PST.

* A new season of “Beast Battlefront” arrives.
 - For this season, the Electric-element “Striking Thunderblade of the Canyon” will be gracing us with their presence as the feature boss.
 - "Beast Battlefront" content will be held twice during the season. The schedule is as follows:
   · 1st Round: 11/28 to 12/10 / Settlement: 12/10 to 12/11 
   · 2nd Round: 12/12 to 12/24 / Settlement: 12/24 to 12/25

* A new season of Portrait of Thierry will be starting.
 - After regular maintenance, monsters differing in attributes from those in the previous seasons will appear in the stages of “Portrait of Thierry.”
 - The new season of "Portrait of Thierry" will end after the regular maintenance on 12/26.

* A new season of Arena will begin.
 - During Arena Season 6, you can earn rewards such as [strike]Tunics[/strike], Emotes and Insignia based on your progress. (Updated 12/2 3:09 AM UTC / 12/1 7:09 PM PDT)
 - The Season 3 rewards will also be available for purchase in the shop during Arena Season 6.
 - Arena Season 6 will end after the regular maintenance on 12/26.

* A new Reward Decree season will start.
 - The new Reward Decree season will begin right after December 1, 2024, and will run until December 31, 2024 6:00 AM UTC / December 30, 2024 10:00 PM PST.

* The "Journey in Memory (Aslan Trial)" event will be held.
 - During this Trial event, you can try out Knights of Veda: 5★ Aslan, 4★ Lucian, and 4★ Orlik.
 - The "Journey in Memory (Aslan Trial)" event will end after the regular  maintenance on 12/26.


[h3][b]■ Improvements[/b][/h3]

* A new feature has been added to inform players how many times a Relic sub-stat has been enhanced.
 - An icon will be displayed beside a sub-stat to show how many times it has been engraved and the grade.
 - For Legendary-grade Relics, the number of enhancement attempts made on sub-stats will be displayed as they appear on levels 4, 8, 12, 16, and 20 respectively.
 - Each time a Relic is Engraved, the affected sub-stats Enhancement count will increase by one.
 - Additionally, the grade of the enhanced sub-stats will be differentiated via the color of the icon. They will be displayed, in the following order: Gray / Green / Blue / Purple / Orange.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/80d5c5658009afa9a140fe4b17f83382952ccbf6.png[/img]

* “FULL AUTO” function Added for Squad Battles.
 - The new “FULL AUTO” function has been added for Squad Battles, allowing you to unleash Overflowing Power of the Stars automatically during battles.

* A new "Organize" Button for Easy Item Disassembly will be added.
 - A new "Organize" button has been added in the item info window. By selecting this button, you can easily choose items to dismantle all at once using the "Batch Register" button in your inventory.
 - You can easily manage the items acquired in the dungeon by reviewing them on the Result Screen, conveniently displayed on the left and right sections.

* Belle Menu Improvements.
 - For content that is still locked to the Master of the Book, a lock icon will appear and the button will be deactivated.
 - For current non-seasonal content (Beast Battlefront, Battlefield of the War Gods, etc.): The text “Preparation” will be displayed.

* You will now be able to change the registered Knight of Veda Deck on the Stage entry screen.

* The maximum number of Relics that can be kept in your inventory will be increased to 2,000.

* The Knight of Veda “Edward” will be adjusted as follows:
 - The “ATK Bonus” applied when using his Signature Skill “Time for Punishment “ will be raised from 50% to 80%.
 - The “Reduce Incoming DMG” effect applied when using his Signature Skill “Time for Punishment” will be increased from 10% to 15%.
 - The DMG increase granted by his Fate Level 6 effect will be raised from 40% to 50%.
 - The ATK SPD increase granted by his Fate Level 6 effect will be raised from 15% to 30%.


[h3][b]■ Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]

* An issue that caused the Knight of Veda “Rhynara” to be recognized as a Melee-type Knight and allowed completion of achievements that need Melee-types to complete will be fixed.
 - Any achievements completed due to this issue will not be removed from users accounts.

We will continue to listen to your feedback to ensure an even more enjoyable adventure in ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

Thank you.

notes.title: Ask Me Anything about ASTRA: Knights of Veda!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/7815891372fa0d8be83d942d6628236ffb409f3c.png[/img]

Masters of the Book,

It has already been a month since we embarked on adventures with all of the Masters of the Book on the Planis continent with Season 2: Tears of the Goddess.

You must have a lot to say about it don’t you?

We know you do, that’s why we prepared an event where Masters of the Book can ask us questions and we’ll receive AND answer them for you; [b]“Ask Me Anything!”[/b]

Please let us know of any questions you might have about the game! Don’t be shy if you’re new to the game or someone who has a lot of experience adventuring through Planis. Everyone will be able to voice their curiosity!

Not only that, everyone who asks will also receive [b]Starstones[/b]! A gift for the curious mind.💌

[h3][b]■ Event Period[/b][/h3]
* November 26, 2024 ~ December 09, 2024 02:59 PM UTC / 06:59 AM PST

[h3][b]■ How to Participate and Rewards[/b][/h3]

 👉[url=https://forms.gle/HWoTrRWWakxd3ms86]’Ask Me Anything HERE’[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/17dde1d0aef8cf747f8287b6c188b210e546aabc.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]■ Notes[/b][/h3]
* Items sent via mail have a validity period of 7 days, so please collect them within this period.

Please keep the questions coming and we’ll try to answer every single one of them.

Thank you.

notes.title: "[Simon’s Amazing Gifts] Guild Treasure Chest” Event Notice
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/283c06158ebf0e7644ece94b54a1530f13460b06.png[/img]

Masters of the Book,

Simon, who runs the Guild Shop, said that he hid a special gift in the 'Fearsome Treasure Chest' that you’ll probably want to check out.

From Thursday to Sunday at 8PM server time, visit your Guild Territory and join the quest to defeat Fearsome Treasure Chests with your guild members and earn various rewards, including the mascot cat [b]'Coco'[/b], 'Starstone,' 'Radiance,' and ' Galactic Bliss'.

[h3][b]■ Event Period[/b][/h3]

* The event is set to start at 08:00 PM server time on the scheduled dates below.
 : November 14, 2024 (Thursday) - November 17, 2024 (Sunday) 
 : November 21, 2024 (Thursday) - November 24, 2024 (Sunday)
* The event will take place a total of [b]8 times[/b] during the event period.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/a001e70314e66308de93b0a46bcbc803cc7e66a4.png[/img]

[h3][b]■ Participation Condition[/b][/h3]
* You can participate in the event after completing the World Mission "Social Party?"
* You can only participate after joining a Guild since this event is exclusively for Guilds.
* You can join the event via the "Simon's Amazing Gifts!" event page under "Guidance of the Book" or from within the Guild territory.

[h3][b]■ How to Participate & Rewards[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/5f6041bbc73b3a419d8dde8949694edfbe264601.png[/img]

* You can participate in the “Simon's Amazing Gifts!” event page or move to the guild territory starting 5 minutes before the event begins.
* When the event starts, a 'Fearsome Treasure Chest' will appear in the center of the guild territory, and it can only be attacked with 'Normal Attacks'.
* The rewards can be claimed within 2 hours from the time of defeating the Fearsome Treasure Chest.
* Defeating the 'Fearsome Treasure Chest' will cause 30 Treasure Chests to appear, and each guild member can open only one Treasure Chest.
* If you have already obtained a Treasure Chest once per day, you cannot receive additional rewards by changing Guilds and re-participating.
* The rewards from the Treasure Chests will not be the same for all Guild members; they will be obtained randomly.
* The mascot [b]'Coco' [/b]can be obtained by up to 5 guild members, and if you have previously obtained 'Coco,' it will be replaced with Crystals of Fate x10.
* When a Treasure Chest containing the Mascot is opened, a pop-up will display the username of the user who obtained it.

[h3][b]■ Notes[/b][/h3]
* The rewards received will be directly credited to your in-game inventory.
* The event can proceed even if all Guild members are not present at the event start time.
* If the 'Fearsome Treasure Chest' is not defeated within the time limit, it will disappear.
* The time period to claim the rewards from the 'Fearsome Treasure Chest' may vary depending on when it was defeated.
* After the time for receiving rewards has passed following the defeat of the 'Fearsome Treasure Chest', you will not be able to claim the 'Treasure Chest', and lost rewards will not be given again.
* For more detailed event precautions, refer to the [b][url=https://account.hybeim.com/en/policies/service/astra/event-policy]<Event Policy>[/url][/b].

Participate in the event and show off [b]'Coco'[/b] to everyone in the tavern!

Thank you.

notes.title: Development Team’s Responses to Your 10/31 Update Comments and Questions
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/9537912f26b3d97de9f44fe9e1c7a78a12fc1b72.png[/img]

Masters of the Book,
I am Kim Young-mo, the director of ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

The highly anticipated Season 2 update, Tears of the Goddess. was finally released on October 31, 2024. We would like to sincerely thank everyone who participated in the launch festivities. The development team is here to answer the feedback and questions you, our Masters of the Book, have shared.

Through your feedback, we feel a greater sense of responsibility in addressing areas of the game that need further improvement. We will make sure to properly review your suggestions and reflect them in a way that would improve the game for Season 2 and beyond.


[h3][b]1. The Experience points required to level up the Master of the Book in Season 2 seem to have increased significantly, which caught many off guard. It’s great that the experience points are higher, but the gap between Master of the Book levels and the Adventure Level Ascension Quests seems to have increased the progression difficulty.[/b][/h3]

We have received numerous feedback about this, and it is one that we can empathize with as we plan to continually review and make changes to it on the difficulty side.

The development team increased the experience points for the Master of the Book level in Season to allow new and returning users to level up quickly and unlock most of the content tied to these levels much faster.

In the process, we anticipated a much slower increase in Knights’ power relative to their Master of the Book level, and thus an increase in the difficulty of levels. While this was the case, we believed that several buffs made to most Knights, and the steady flow of resources given to users compared to those given from the Open Beta, made it so that clearing Adventure Zones shouldn’t be too difficult. 

However, rest assured that we will continue to monitor the situation and make adjustments to Ascension Quests or Adventure Zones that are proving to be too difficult.


[h3][b]2. We’re enjoying the addition of Squad Battles, but it seems like the monsters in it feel stronger. Are there any differences with monster HP values?[/b][/h3]

For Season 2, the development team has made Squad Battle the foundational battle mode. In Squad Battle, all four Knights are actively on the field, which increases enemy health accordingly. 

After taking advantage of synergies with Knight combinations and stats, it became possible to break through the Adventure Zone using Squad Battle. However, if progress became difficult, we designed a play experience that allows you to challenge harder areas through Normal Battle or Co-Op, offering a more strategic approach to overcoming tough obstacles.


[h3][b]3. Most of the Knights added in Season 1 haven't had story quests attached to them. Are there any plans to add Story Quests to them?[/b][/h3]

The Knights released in Season 1 continue to advance their quests and agendas within the world of ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

The characters in the main story will continue to evolve, with additional storylines added over time. For the external characters with significant episodes, we will prioritize important updates and release them gradually.


[h3][b]4. I was really looking forward to the release of Season 2, but then I noticed that most of the new content added has been for the end-game. Are there any plans to add content for those still starting or at an intermediate level?[/b][/h3]

In an earlier Director’s Letter, we briefly introduced some content that will be added to the game’s subsequent updates.

We are currently monitoring the difficulty of content like Portrait of Thierry, Beast Battlefront, and the Ancient Golden City, as they seem to present a significant barrier for beginners. 

As a development team, our first priority has always been to design the difficulty of all content, future or existing, with high quality, ensuring that players of all skills levels can still have a satisfying gameplay experience. With that in mind, we will continue to adjust the balance of existing content and add more challenging high-level content to match the progression of users.

The most important part in building powerful Knights in ASTRA: Knights of Veda has always been Item Setup, the most critical of which is the Relic setup. We believe that properly setting artifacts is a key skill for anyone wishing to master the game.

The Development Team is currently exploring various ways to make Relic setup and the checking of item stats easier for beginners. Once we finalize the direction for this update, we will share it with you all.


[h3][b]5. The stress brought about by the pity system is quite high, especially when consecutive pity pulls occur, bringing extreme disappointment. Could you ease the pity system or allow us to choose between a 100% guaranteed pity pull after 100 summons or a 50% pull after 70 summons.[/b][/h3]

"Call of the Stars" is an area that requires careful consideration for various reasons. We fully understand the stress users may experience in this area and are working on measures that will satisfy a wide range of players. 

We will share these updates as soon as possible. While there is ongoing discussion, please note that since it is a system that has already been commercialized, we must approach any changes with caution. We appreciate your understanding and patience.


That concludes the answers to the topics that we thought you might be curious about regarding the Season 2 update.

As announced on a previous Developer Note, after the Season 2 “Tears of the Goddess” update, we plan to introduce “Trials of the Celestial”, “Nightmare Dungeon of the Deep Abyss”, “World Bosses”, and the Mythic-grade for Weapons and Knights. This, alongside some other planned content and improvements that we are still to introduce in future updates.

We would like to thank all our Masters of the Book, who are still with us and who joined us for Season 2, “Tears of the Goddess”.

A full roadmap for Season 2 will be provided soon, combining both the planned developments and improvements to existing content.

Thank you.
