notes.title: 5/2 Update Details (Updated 5/2 06:09 UTC)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/036f35657ff085a1e2b835901aa669652937280e.jpg[/img]

Masters of the Book, 

The veiled woman traversing moonlight ‘Lightning-fast Arrow’ Aurora has arrived.
The "One Week’s Journey" event is now live, offering a range of enhancement materials for logging in daily over a week. Together with the rebooted "Fateful Encounter," this event supports the progression of all Masters of the Book who join us in ASTRA: Knights of Veda. From Thursday to Sunday, experience the thrill of survival in the "Arena Survival – For the Thrill of Survival" and face new challenges in the "Tower of Trials." Prepare to discover your enhanced abilities!

Keep reading for more details about what’s coming!

[h1] ■ Update [/h1]
[list] 
[*]The new 5★ character, Aurora, is here. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/7ad43e747a2bebf5157e781e3edcbdb0b2d4a844.png[/img]


[code] [b]"I followed the thread of destiny"[/b]
Every time the moonlight appears, Aurora vanishes suddenly, her true intentions known to none. She roams the world in search of the Book, concealing her innermost thoughts, leaving her true motives wrapped in mystery. [/code]

"Aurora" is a Light-type ranged dealer, wielding a large bow. When she deals CRIT DMG with her Normal ATKs, she gains the "Retribution" effect to amplify DMG dealt. Her Normal Skill, "Arrow Festival", allows her to dodge backwards while firing arrows to keep incoming enemies at bay. Her Signature Skill, "Light-Speed Kicks", deals DMG to nearby enemies, and after dealing CRIT DMG for a period of time, she gains the "Extermination" effect, allowing her to finish off enemies with even more power.

[*]  A new 4★ Knight of Veda, Elias, has been released. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/6bbfce7688e8292a78ba0e7272b4f5af3c01a74e.png[/img]

[code] [b]"Rules are Rules!"[/b]
He is renowned for being an unwavering believer in his principles, refusing to make any compromises. His steadfast dedication to his principles has earned him the nickname, "That's what Elias would do," a phrase often used to describe someone inflexible. However, his unwavering principles have made him stronger, and his selfless devotion to the House of Segric compels him to embark on a new adventure.
[/code] 

“Elias” is a Electric-type Melee DPS wielding a Large Axe, electrocuting enemies and dealing CRIT for an explosive match. Normal Skill “Lesson of Principles” wields an axe to electrocute targets and their nearby enemies. Signature Skill “Lightning Leap” leaps up lightning-fast and lands an axe to deal wide-area electric DMG.

[*] - New content, ‘Survival Arena,’ is being added.
   · Survival Arena is open 4 days a week, Thursday through till Sunday, where up to 10 Masters of the Book can engage in battles to be the last Master of the Book standing. 
   · The longer the match, the smaller the arena shrinks, and the map is filled with various buffs and hiding spots to launch a surprise attack. 
   · Crowns of Victory will be distributed according to placement, and progression rewards will also be obtained.
   · You can access ‘Survival Arena’ from the Arena menu. 
[*]  A new ‘Survival Arena’ season begins. 
   · During the new ‘Survival Arena’ season, you can participate in events, complete missions, and earn great rewards. 
   ·  The ‘Survival Arena’ will conclude after the 5/30 maintenance. 
[*] A new Tower of Trials season begins
   · Floors 9 to 12 of the Tower of Trials have been reset, and new blessings, and the Goddess’ Arrangement will be applied. 
   · The new Tower of Trials season will conclude during the 5/30 maintenance. 
[*] The ‘Weekly Journey’ attendance event begins.
   · Log into the game for 7 days and receive various rewards. 
   · The ‘Weekly Journey’ event ends during the 5/16 maintenance. 
[*] Added new Birthday Features for Masters of the Book, Belle, and the Knights of Veda
   · On each birthday, you’ll receive a special letter and rewards. 
[/list] 

[h1] ■ Improvements [/h1]

[h3]Xanthia[/h3]
[*] Xanthia’s teleport (evasion), will have the cooldown reduced by 30%, from 2 seconds to 1.4 seconds. 
[*] The damage from the normal skill "Law of Gravity" and Signature Skill "Event Horizon," was previously distributed evenly, will now be segmented into early, mid, and late stages. 

[b]‘Law of Gravity’[/b]
(Before) 9.44% 10 Hits (total 94.4% damage)
(After) 18.8% 2 hits, 12.56% 3 hits, 7.52% 5 hits (total 112.88% damage) 

[b]‘Event Horizon’[/b]
(Before) 27.12% 10 Hits (total 271.2% damage)
(After) 54.24% 2 hits, 36.16% 3 hits, 21.68% 5 hits (total 325.26% damage)

[b]‘Event Horizon’ (With Fate 2 or higher)[/b]
(Before) 27.12% 15 hits (total 406.8% damage)
(After) 54.24% 3 hits, 36.16% 5hits, 21.68% 7hits (total 508.8% damage)


[h3] Albert [/h3]
[*] Albert’s base damage threshold will be increased by 30% (applies to all Knights of Veda with Defense-based damage)

[b]‘Sacred Hammer’[/b]
(Before) Projectile Damage = DEF-Based 11.06%, AoE DMG = DEF-based 55.34%
(After) Projectile Damage = DEF-Based 14.46%, AoE DMG = DEF-based 72.37%

[b]‘Roar of the Golden Lion’[/b]
(Before) Statue Fall DMG = DEF-Based 43.67%, 'Leap of the Golden Lion' DMG = DEF-based 14.7%
(After) Statue Fall DMG = DEF-Based 57.11%, 'Leap of the Golden Lion' DMG = DEF-based 19.22%

[b]‘Roar of the Golden Lion’ (Fate 2 or higher)[/b]
(Before) Statue Fall DMG = DEF-Based 53.94%,  'Leap of the Golden Lion' DMG = DEF-based 17.65%
(After) Statue Fall DMG = DEF-Based 70.52%,  'Leap of the Golden Lion' DMG = DEF-based  23.08%

[*]The third strike of “Power of Earth” (normal attack) will be changed to defense-based damage. 
Damage will change from ATK 72% to DEF-based 55.38%
[*]Albert’s ‘Leap of the Golden Lion’ (Signature Extend) will have its Veda Energy requirement reduced from 180 to 120, a 33% reduction. 


[h3]Atterisee[/h3]
[*]Atterisee’s teleport (evasion), will have the cooldown reduced by 30%, from 2 seconds to 1.4 seconds. 
[*]The hit rate of the bear summoned by Atterisee’s “Roll, Roll, Roll!” skill will be reduced by 33%, allowing for more hits to connect. 
[*]Atterisee’s ‘Venomous Explosion’ (Strong Attack) charging time for each stage will be reduced by 30%.
[*] Targets hit by ‘Venomous Explosion’ (Strong Attack) will now receive a 10% movement speed reduction effect. 
[*] Research Pays Off (Signature Skill) will have the “Reduce Incoming Heal” replaced with “Decreased Defense”. Additionally, all debuff effect times will be increased from 2 seconds to 3 seconds.

(Before) Reduces ATK 20%,Reduced Incoming Heal 50%, Reduce All RES 30% (one effect applied randomly) 
(After) Reduces ATK 20%, Reduces DEF 30%, Reduce All RES 30% (one effect applied randomly) 
With Fate 6, the defense reduction effect will increase to 50% 


[h3]Lucian[/h3]
[*]Lucian’s ‘Holy Sword Blessing’ cooldown will be reduced from 40 seconds, to 30 seconds (25% decrease). 
[*]The duration of ‘Holy Sword Blessing’ will increase to 23 seconds, regardless of Fate Level.


[h3]Andrei[/h3]
[*]The range of ‘Red Meteorite’ (Normal Skill) will increase by 33%, and with Fate 6, it will increase an additional 25% of the original. 
[*]The hit range of ‘Narcissistic Flame’ (Strong Attack) will increase by 33% for the first 3 stages, and for the 4th stage, it will increase an additional 25% compared to the original. 


[h3]Yanko[/h3]
[*]The damage for ‘Mechanic Arrow’ (Basic Attack) will increase by approximately 20%. 
[*]The damage for ‘Weakness Calculation’ (Strong Attack) will be increased by approximately 20%.


[h3]Orlik[/h3] 
[*]Orlik’s base damage threshold will be increased by 30% (applies to all Knights of Veda with Defense-based damage). 

[b]‘Earth Smash’[/b] 
(Before) DEF-based 19%
(After) DEF-based 24%

[*]The third strike of ‘Strong Determination’ (Basic Attack) will be changed to DEF-based damage.
82.8% of ATK power -> DEF-based 63.69%


[h3]Leon[/h3]
[*]Leon’s base damage threshold will be increased by 30% (applies to all Knights of Veda with Defense-based damage). 

[b]‘Indomitable Will’ (Less than Fate 4)[/b]
(Before) DEF-based 17.24%
(After) DEF-based 22.54%

[b]‘Indomitable Will’ (Fate 4 or higher)[/b]
(Before) DEF-based 18.35%
(After) DEF-based 24%

[*]The third strike of ‘Justice’ (Basic Attack) will be changed to DEF-based damage
55.2% of ATK power -> DEF-based 42.46%

[h3]Veleno[/h3]
[*]The casting time of ‘Venomous Arrow’ will be reduced, resulting in an approximately 20% decrease in casting time.

[h3] Miscellaneous Improvements[/h3] 
[*] Fixed an issue where the stat increase rate of ‘Elemental ATK power’ option stat was the same as ‘ATK power’. 
[*]The stat increase rate of ‘Elemental ATK power’ will be adjusted to be higher than the stat increase rate of ‘ATK power’
[*]Fixed an issue where ‘Movement Speed’ and ‘Attack Speed’ options for items would not add together. 
[*]The ‘Guard Rate’ stat from items is to be capped, and no longer increase more than 80%. 
[*]The optional stat, ‘Reduce Veda Energy Consumption’ from items is to be capped at 35%. 
[*]Each ‘Event Call of the Stars (Knight of Veda)’ will now share their 50/50 status. 
   · 50/50 means that if the most recently obtained 5★ is not the target Knight, the next time a 5★ is pulled, it is guaranteed to be the target Knight.
   · If both currently on-going ‘Event Call of the Stars’ are guaranteed to pull the highlighted 5★, the target will be obtained until all 50/50’s have been resolved. 

[b]2 Outstanding Guaranteed Target 5★Knights of Veda[/b]
For example, if the ‘Black Sun Event Call of the Stars’ (Xanthia) is guaranteed to give you the target Knight (Xanthia), and the ‘Gifted Doctor Event Call of the Stars’ (Veleno) is also guaranteed to give you the target Knight (Veleno), after the 5/2 update, obtaining a 5★ Knight from either the ‘Gifted Doctor’ (Veleno) or ‘Lightning-fast arrow’ (Aurora) will guarantee the target character twice (once for each Event Call of the Stars banner). 

[b]1 Outstanding Guaranteed Target 5★Knights of Veda[/b]
If only one of the current banners is guaranteed to give you the target 5★Knight of veda, then you will only have one guaranteed target 5★ Knight. 

[b]0 Outstanding Guaranteed Target 5★Knights of Veda[/b]
If you have no outstanding 50/50’s from the ‘Event Call of the Stars’, then there will be no guaranteed target 5★Knight. 

[*]The “Exclusive Weapon Call of the Stars” will also be modified to carry the same 50/50 rules as the “Event Call of the Stars (Knight of Veda)”.
[*]Reconnecting to the game will now restart you in the same area as when you disconnected, instead of from the Nightmare. 
[*]The ability to adjust your Adventure Level downward has been improved, and you can now drop down 2 Adventure Levels instead of 1. 
[*]You will now see up to 2 World Missions on the main screen, making tracking these missions easier. 
[*]The rewards for completing the ‘Journey in Memory’ for 4★ characters will be improved. 
   · (Before) Gold x3,000, Wanderer’s Record x3, Insignia of Victory x1
   · (After) Gold x4,000, Wanderer’s Record x5, Insignia of Victory x1

[*]To easily identify parts of a Relic Set that you own, each part’s icon will be displayed on the relic icon. This will make it more convenient to equip and unequip relics. 
[*]The number of Relics sold in the Arena Shop will be increased from 4 to 10. 
[*]You will be able to see the tooltip for items when using them as materials, allowing you to carefully select which items you use to enhance with. 
[*]Within the Equipment Collection, the Accessory tab will be improved to resemble an ‘Artifact Collection’, displaying accessories that share the same name and main stats in convenient groups, making them easier to differentiate. 
[*]The Monster Collection will be improved to allow you to view various strategic tips on how to take down the monsters. 
[*]The Log Collection will be improved to allow easier viewing of your journey so far. A playback button will be added so that you can clearly see which video you are watching. Also images for each video will be added in the future to further improve the experience. 
[*] When stiffness stacks from hits/damage, the applied stiffness duration will gradually shorten. This affects both other players and monsters. (5/2 06:09 UTC)

[h1] ■ Bug Fixes[/h1] [list] 
[*]The issue where the poison damage included in Knight of Veda 'Veleno's' skill did not increase with skill level will be fixed.
[*]The issue where the burn damage included in Knight of Veda 'Edward's' skill did not increase with skill level will be fixed.
[*]The issue where the burn damage included in Knight of Veda 'Andrei's' skill did not increase with skill level will be fixed.
[*]The issue where the bleeding damage included in Knight of Veda 'Eliyar's' skill did not increase with skill level will be fixed.
[*]The problem where the support character information was not reflected in the stage entry screen’s appropriate level color and recommended attribute activation feature will be corrected.
[*]The issue where clicking near the close button on the Arena main screen displayed the Arena medal details will be fixed.
[*]The issue where item icons overlapped in the item return guidance popup will be fixed.
[*]The issue where the bottom area of the inventory appeared cut off will be fixed.
[*]The text size of added options in the relic enhancement result screen will be enlarged.
[*]An error popup will no longer appear when requesting support for a Knight of Veda that is already in the deck.
[*]For Masters of the Book at the maximum level, the experience points displayed in the dungeon guide window will be correctly converted to gold.
[*]Abnormal movements of party members in auto-battle mode after clearing a dungeon together will be fixed.
[*]The issue of the Black Prince not moving intermittently during party play in Chapter 7 Stage 12 of the adventure dungeon will be corrected.
[*]The game freezing at certain steps in the Tower of Trials will be resolved.
[*]Equipment icons appearing abnormally in the equipment enhancement result window will be corrected.
[*]Blacklisted users will no longer appear in the recent list of friends.
[*]The intermittent flashing of the shoe recharge popup will be fixed.

notes.title: Director's First Update on Future Plans Pt. 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/d9584f71da4a41f954c70a084ef74d6d341d7a88.png[/img]

Hello, Masters of the Book, this is Youngmo Kim, Director of ASTRA: Knights of Veda.
We sincerely appreciate your love and enjoyment of ASTRA: Knights of Veda, despite its various shortcomings. We apologize for the delay in our communications through developer's notes, as our priority has been to address urgent issues. Today, I'd like to provide further details that were not fully covered in my initial letter.


[h2]Frequent Feedback on the Balance of Knights of Veda[/h2]
After the adjustment of the [Ignore DEF(%)] stat on April 18, we are preparing for further stat adjustments on May 2. We ask for your understanding in advance and aim to provide an early explanation of these adjustments.
Many of you have commented on the change to the [Ignore DEF(%)] value on April 18. High-level players, who primarily farm mobs with high defense (higher levels and grades), have found that [Ignore DEF(%)] provides up to three times greater efficiency than [Attack Power(%)], reducing the value of other options. This imbalance necessitated a prompt revision.

It was a necessary step to refine the balance of current and future Knights of Veda and their equipment. However, the significant adjustments disappointed many players, and we sincerely apologize for not explaining these changes adequately beforehand.
As previously mentioned, when a specific stat or capability becomes overly dominant, it undermines the relevance of other options, making rebalancing necessary. Ideally, these issues should have been identified and addressed during testing. We apologize for this oversight and assure you that we are committed to preventing similar issues in the future.

[h2]Upcoming Adjustments on May 2:[/h2]
The issue where the stat increase of the [Elemental ATK] on rings was inadvertently set to half of the intended amount will be corrected. 
Additionally, a problem where the [Movement SPD] and [ATK SPD] stats were not being properly combined will also be fixed.
For rings increasing in [Elemental ATK], the base value for [ATK] was initially set to double that of [Attack Power], but the stat increase was mistakenly set to match that of [ATK]. This will be corrected to reflect the intended design of doubling the stat increase of [ATK].

Unlike [ATK], [Elemental ATK] does not benefit from the [ATK(%)] option, hence it has a higher base value. If [ATK(%)] is kept below a certain threshold, [Elemental ATK] proves to be more efficient, and if it is above that, [ATK] becomes more efficient.

[h3]Cap Limitations:[/h3]
Furthermore, we will implement caps on the stats for [Guard Rate] and [Reduce Veda Energy Consumption]. The cap for [Guard Rate] will be set at 80%, and for [Reduce Veda Energy Consumption], it will be 30%.

[Guard Rate] is an option available only to Knights of Veda who have 'guard' type heavy attacks. These knights inherently possess a certain level of [Guard Rate], making it one of the easier stats to enhance. While achieving 100% is relatively simple, at this level, guarding consumes no stamina, which could lead to unexpected behaviors and problems in various content, hence the need for adjustment.

Considering the limited number of knights that can use the [Guard Rate] stat and to maintain competitiveness with other option stats, we have decided not to significantly reduce its effectiveness. Instead, we are setting a cap at 80%, allowing Masters of the Book to select this stat up to the cap or choose other options as needed.

As for the [Reduce Veda Energy Consumption] stat, setting it to 100% could prevent any Veda Energy usage, which might lead to unintended gameplay issues. Exceeding specific thresholds could also undermine the effectiveness of other game mechanics like 'Sync Rate,' 'Skill Effects,' and 'Relic Set Options.' To avoid these issues, we've decided to cap this stat at 30%. We understand that reaching this cap may be difficult for some players, but maintaining a balanced and diverse strategic environment is crucial for enhancing the gameplay experience.

Furthermore, we will proceed with balance adjustments for specific Knights of Veda in the upcoming May 2 update. Details of these adjustments will be provided in the patch notes. Our aim is to minimize the frequency of balance changes and to focus more on buffs rather than nerfs to ensure a fair and enjoyable game environment for all players.

[h3]Xanthia[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Cooldown for teleportation (dodge) will be reduced. 
[*] The damage from the normal skill "Law of Gravity" and Signature Skill "Event Horizon," was previously distributed evenly, will now be segmented into early, mid, and late stages. The initial damage will be more potent, decreasing as it progresses to the later stages.
[/olist]

[h3]Albert[/h3]
[olist]
[*] The base damage threshold on Defense-based Knights will be adjusted to increase the damage ratio (applies to all Knights of Veda with Defense-based damage)
[*] The third strike of “Power of Earth” (normal attack) will be changed to defense-based damage. 
[*] The Veda Energy cost of the Signature Skill “The Roar of the Golden Lion” will be reduced. 
[/olist]

[h3]Atterisee[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Cooldown for teleportation (dodge) will be reduced. 
[*] Roll, Roll, Roll! (Normal Skill) - When the animated bear charges, the interval between hits will be reduced, allowing it to push targets more effectively. Damage during the charge will be adjusted accordingly.
[*] The Strong Attack charge time will be reduced, and a movement speed reduction effect will be added. 
[*] Research Pays Off (Signature Skill) will have the “Reduce Incoming Heal” replaced with “Decreased Defense”. 
Before: (1) Reduces ATK, (2) Reduce Incoming Heal, (3) Reduce All RES
After: (1) Reduces ATK, (2) Reduce DEF, (3) Reduce All RES
[*] The duration of debuffs granted by “Research Pays Off” will be increased. 
[/olist]

[h3]Lucian[/h3]
[olist]
[*] “Holy Sword of Blessing” (Normal Skill) will have its cooldown reduced and its duration increased.
[/olist] 

Andrei
[olist]
[*] The range of “Red Meteorite” (Normal Skill) and “Narcissistic Flame” (Strong Attack) will be increased.  
[*] The damage of “Red Meteorite” (Normal Skill) and “Narcissistic Flame” (Strong Attack) will be increased.
[/olist]  

[h3]Yanko[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Scaling for “Mechanic Arrow” (Basic Attack) will be increased. 
[*] Scaling for “Weakness Calculation” (Strong Attack) will be increased. 
[/olist]

Orlik
[olist]
[*] The base damage threshold on Defense-based Knights will be adjusted to increase the damage ratio (applies to all Knights of Veda with Defense-based damage. 
[*] The third strike of Orlik’s Strong Determination (Normal Attack) will be changed to Defense-based damage. 
[/olist]

[h3]Leon[/h3]
[olist]
[*] The base damage threshold on Defense-based Knights will be adjusted to increase the damage ratio (applies to all Knights of Veda with Defense-based damage. 
[*] The third strike of Leon’s “Justice!” (Normal Attack) will be changed to defense-based damage. 
[/olist]

Additionally, since launch, many Masters of the Book have enjoyed participating in Arena, and we have been closely monitoring the sentiment that Melee Knights of Veda are at a disadvantage compared to ranged Knights of Veda. The matches between melee and ranged are finely balanced, with the low stagger and tenacity of ranged Knights vs the high stagger and tenacity of melee ones playing a key role in balancing between the two. However we are aware of the disadvantages that melee Knights of Veda can run into, especially when facing highly specialized and effective ranged knights in the active 3v3 arena.

Currently, we are balancing the tenacity values of melee Veda Knights, and we are considering reducing the duration of stagger when it occurs repeatedly upon being hit. We are striving to obtain balanced test results, and update as quickly as possible. 
Once again, we feel a heavy responsibility for not predicting these situations earlier, and apologize for any inconvenience caused. 

[h2]The 50/50 Issue[/h2]
We’ve received a lot of feedback regarding the topic of the 50/50 not being shared across pickup character banners. The development team heavily underestimated the impact that having this focused on one character instead of both would have. We have listened to your feedback, and the 50/50 will be shared across multiple banners starting from the May 2 update. 

[h2]Inconvenience associated with forming parties[/h2]
We plan to introduce an automatic matching feature to streamline party formation without needing friend requests, allowing for quick re-invitations of previous party members. We aim to launch this update by May 16 and will provide a detailed schedule in due course.
We sincerely apologize for any shortcomings and assure you of our commitment to continually enhancing the game. We are dedicated to promptly addressing your feedback and understand the frustration and disappointment caused by ongoing issues and balance adjustments. 

To address this, we have prepared a small login event as follows:
From April 24 to May 2, participants will receive 200 Starstones daily, amounting to a total of 1,600 Starstones over the eight days.
Thank you for your understanding and support.
Best regards,
Youngmo Kim

notes.title: Director's First Update on Future Plans
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/0d66f6b0ad34d439dbfab04e8707cf0df1b4b73b.png[/img]

Hello, Masters of the Book. I'm Youngmo Kim.

Entering the third week following the launch of ASTRA: Knights of Veda on April 2nd, I want to emphasize that delivering excellent content and service remains our utmost priority. Despite our efforts, both the development team and our publishers HYBE IM acknowledge there have been shortcomings, particularly in addressing user inconveniences and our communication.

We are committed to attentively listening to every piece of feedback provided by our players on Discord and other community platforms. While we wish to respond to everyone's feedback individually, some responses and decisions require more time, and we apologize for any delays in communication.

We apologize for the recent update that decreased the efficiency of the ignore-defense option and reduced the capabilities of Capecchi. We understand this has caused significant frustration for users who invested time and resources into developing their characters. In a game where collecting characters is key, it is our responsibility to ensure thorough testing, and we regret that we fell short.

We will issue further details on the adjustments to character balance, options, and stats through an additional developer's note this week. Unlike previous practices, we will provide these details well in advance of the next update, ensuring there's ample time for community feedback. 

An upcoming developer note will also address the heavily discussed topic of the Character rate-up events, and the potential improvements we can make to them. 

Additionally, the upcoming developer's note will address the frequently discussed topics of the 50/50 system on the Event Call of the Stars and potential improvements we can make to it.

Actions speak louder than words. We are committed to addressing the areas of discomfort you've experienced and will continue to make visible improvements, even if progress seems slow at times. We promise to do our utmost with all the resources at our disposal.

This coming update on April 25th will focus on implementing changes based on the continuous feedback we've received. We are always doing our best to improve your experience with each update we roll out.

The maximum number of shoes will be increased from 160 to 240, and the recharge time for one shoe will be reduced from 8 minutes to 6 minutes. The support Knights will also be modified, bringing the level range from -5 to +2 up to -5 to +5. 
 
We also intend to make some changes to Veleno, the Knight of Veda added last week. 

[list]
[*] Regular attacks and signature skills will be modified so she doesn’t track backwards. 
[*] The projectile range of Veleno’s strong attack will increase by 33%. 
[*] Veleno’s Strong attack will penetrate one target when charged to the second stage. 
[*] During Auto-battle, the Knight of Veda 'Veleno' will maintain a certain distance from the target and use normal skills.
[/list] 

Changes to Option Stats:
[list]
[*]The baseline value for DoT damage will increase by a factor of 2.33 compared to its previous value (Example: 9%>21%). 
[/list] 
 
Additionally, there are a lot of things that we can improve on, such as the shortcomings of the party system, lack of content, insufficient on-time rewards and the lack of events. We want to make corrections and improvements as quickly as possible, but we will prioritize the most important issues and then work through everything sequentially. 
 
We’re working hard to prepare announcements of major content updates that we have planned for the future, and once we’re ready, we will make sure to announce it without hesitation. 

Once again, I apologize for the shortcomings of ASTRA: Knights of Veda so far, and we want to ensure that we can live up to your enthusiasm for the game. 
 
Thank you

 - Adventurer’s Shoes used + (Number of Hero’s Shoes x 80)
[b]2. Calculate the number of Hero’s Shoes used in co-op at Adventure Level 6 or higher[/b]
 - The number of Hero’s Shoes used in co-op (2 or 3-player) at Adventure Level 6 or higher x80
[b]3. Compensate with Hero’s Shoes equivalent to 1.5 times the quantity of shoes remaining after excluding the number of Hero’s Shoes used in a party at Adventure Level 6 or higher from the total shoe count. [/b]
 - ((point 1 – point 2) x 1.5) divided by 80 (rounded to the nearest whole number)
[b]4. Minimum compensated Hero’s Shoes is set at 5[/b]
 - If the result from Step 3 is between 0 and 4 pairs of Hero’s Shoes, 5 shoes will be sent.


※ Compensation will not be provided to the 189 accounts that were subject to the account restrictions
※ A maximum of 5 Hero’s Shoes can be held at a time. 
 - If you cannot receive the rewards attached to your mail, please make sure to use all Hero’s Shoes you possess, then attempt to collect the mail again. 
※ The deadline for collecting the Hero’s Shoes is June 1, 2024 05:59 (UTC), May 31, 2024 10:59 PM (PDT) 
[/code]

Additionally, for those Masters of the Book who are just starting out, we plan to provide Hero’s Shoes to your in-game mail. Please check the details below. 

[h3]■ Support for New Masters of the Book[/h3]
 - Support Period: April 18, after maintenance - June 1, 2024 05:59 (UTC), May 31, 2024 10:59 PM (PDT) 
 - Eligible Accounts: Accounts made after April 16, 2024  06:40 (UTC), April 15 11:40 PM (PDT)
 - Support Item : Hero’s Shoes x5
※ The storage period for the mail containing support items is 30 days from the date of issuance.

We apologize once more to all Masters of the Book who are dissatisfied with the recent issues and errors, which have hindered us in our ability to provide a satisfactory game experience. 

We promise that we will do our best to ensure that similar issues do not occur in the future. We value your feedback, and strive to provide an even more enjoyable experience. 

Thank you

notes.title: 4/18 Update Details (Last Updated 4/18 05:06 UTC)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/87b0a44139e8ce1ba75f608a64b3ec4c7ebf2ded.png[/img]

Masters of the Book! 

The “Gifted Doctor” Veleno is here! After the Day of Tragedy, Veleno has been sacrificing everything in order to find a cure for the Undead, and bring life back to the lands. But what has she been doing? What has been going on between her and the Spoiled Princess Atterisee? Explore the caves where danger lurks, and explore their ties. 

In addition to the Special Material Transport Mission, where you transport materials to predetermined goals to earn rewards, we’ve prepared other improvements to assist you on your Adventures! 

Let’s take a look at what is coming in the 4/18 update! 

[h1]■ Update [/h1]
- A new 5★ Knight of Veda, ‘Veleno’ appears. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/38b40a744a2b982fc04be4ed3d9f50c2c8fcd2a3.png[/img]

[code][b]"If you can understand the cause, then you can change the outcome"[/b]

Born with the qualities of a great doctor, she is willing to make personal sacrifices to aid others. Even in the face of the events of the Day of the Tragedy, Veleno holds a belief that she falls short because she has not yet found a cure for the undead. She will tirelessly delve into the study of poisons, subjecting herself to constant anguish, until she discovers a means to heal the wandering souls in Darkness...[/code]

[list]
[*] “Veleno” is a ranged Poison DPS who wields a small bow, and releases multiple arrows with concentrated poison at her enemies.
With her Normal Skill "Great Doctor's Poison Fog," Veleno swiftly evades backwards while releasing an area attack that deals poison damage to enemies. Veleno's Signature Skill, "Metastases of Poisoning" inflicts "Lethal Poison" to enemies pierced by her arrows, metastasizing poison to all foes nearby. All her attacks for a certain period will inflict poisoning, maximizing damage. 
Join the new missions and content introduced along with the “Gifted Doctor” Veleno to test her skills. 
[/list]

[list]
[*] New hero missions, “The Green Doctor and the Spoiled Princess” will be added. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/c0aae0e007f19e6122b3f34677cb26b585bf89be.png[/img]
[i]The Master of the Book encounters a stubborn child in a cave where danger lurks. Behind their confident demeanor, an intriguing mystery dwells. [/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/e9f4cf0be0dd724b1ce1af2bcf20cbbc4ecc46a6.png[/img]
[i]As they unravel the mystery, perilous situations occur. At the end of it all, deeply buried secrets begin to reveal…[/i]

[*] Through the mission “The Green Doctor and the Stubborn Princess,” you can progress through the story of the newest Knight of Veda, “Veleno.”
[*] ‘Green Doctor and the Spoiled Princess’ can be picked up after clearing Adventure Stage 3-10, and can be collected from Demona. 
[*] Special Supply Delivery Operation has been added. 
- The new event, “Special Supply Delivery Operation” involves escorting materials from various regions. - Select your knights based on their elements to get the most out of the mission. 
- Each stage consists of 3 rounds, and you gain buffs by completing rounds 1 and 2. 
- Escort the wagon to its destination to obtain rewards. 
- The “Special Supply Delivery Operation” will end after the May 16 Maintenance. 
 
[*] Journey in Memory, Veleno Experience, will be added. 
- In this event, you can experience the newest Knight of Veda, Veleno(5★), along with Liam (4★), Marthel (4★), and Rani (4★).
- ‘Journey in Memory (Veleno Experience)’ will end after the May 16 Maintenance.
[/list]

[h1]■ Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] A new Auto-mode will be added that will utilize all Knights of Veda in a team. 
- Auto-Battle will be divided into Full and Semi automatic modes. 
- FULL Mode will automatically trigger the Overflowing Power of the Stars, and will switch your Knights of Veda to make full use of skills (Priority is given in Team Order). 
- For players who prefer to manually switch knights based on their own judgment, the SEMI mode allows them to engage in automatic combat as before.
- You can toggle through the available auto-modes by pressing the Auto-battle multiple times. (OFF → FULL → SEMI → OFF)
[*] The attribute icons will be changed to make it easier to identify an enemy's attribute. 
[*] The filter for Relics will be improved so that it will filter for all Relics, and not just the current Relic slot. 
[*] Viewing cutscenes in the log collection will be improved. Whereas previously it was divided into multiple small sections, the cutscenes will now play continuously, allowing you to immerse yourself in the story. 
[*] In the Adventure Guide, the number of current Hero’s Shoes will be displayed, and an icon to check which blessings are currently active in Tower of Trials will also be added. 
[*]The number of daily shoe charges will increase from 8 times to 10 times, and the cost to charge shoes after 8 times does not increase. (Added 4/18 05:03 UTC)
[/list]

[h1]■ Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The intermittent targeting issue with the Knight of Veda 'Albert's' normal skill will be fixed.
[*] The damage of Knight of Veda 'Xanthia's' normal skill will increase from 7.4% to 9.44%.
[*] The activation time for Knight of Veda 'Atterisee's' normal skill will decrease from 0.27 seconds to 0.15 seconds.
[*] The throwing angle of Knight of Veda 'Atterisee's' normal attack will be lowered, reducing the time it takes to reach the target and increasing the likelihood of getting closer targets.
[*] The damage of Knight of Veda 'Capecchi' normal skill will be reduced. (From 24.72% to 12.32%, and for Fate Level 2 from 30.88% to 15.44%)
- Adjustments have been made after confirming that the existing hit count criteria was incorrectly set, resulting in higher than expected damage.
[*] An error where activating the fourth Fate level of the Knight of Veda 'Capecchi' incorrectly increased the duration of his Signature Skill has been identified and will be fixed.
[*] The Ignore DEF Rate (%) value applied to all items will be halved
- The Ignore DEF Rate option has abnormally high expected damage output compared to other options. 
- This change will apply to all item stats including equipment, relics, gems, and enchantments (skill-applied stats will not be changed).
[*] Restrictions based on the Master of the Book's level will now be applied to the list of Knights of Veda available through the Support Knight system.
- Previously: No level restrictions for friend and guild support.
- Changed: For friend and guild support, the supported Knights are limited to those whose Masters of the Book's levels are within a range of -5 to +2 of the player’s level.
[*] The issue where the dialogue gets cut off if you move ahead of Lionel during 'Lionel's Guide' will be fixed.
[*] In Chapter 4, Stage 12, and Chapter 5, Stage 12, the problem with the NPCs' bodies disappearing immediately upon death during combat will be fixed.
[*] The issue where the 'Awakened Knight' quest in Chapter 5, Stage 2 cannot be completed normally when progressing in auto co-op mode will be fixed.
[*] The problem in Chapter 7, Stage 6, where players get stuck in trap sections during auto-battle and cannot progress, will be fixed.
[*] The issue where the mid-boss in Chapter 5 of Veda's Nightmare does not attack when approached will be fixed.
[*] The issue where navigation does not appear for items only listed in the substitution list in the inventory will be fixed.
[*] An issue where in certain circumstances an error message would appear when enhancing relics will be fixed. 
[*] An issue where the guild chat window displayed the earliest entered chat message when checking the chat again will be fixed. 
[*] An issue where clicking a World Mission, with other sub-missions active would cause missions to reorganize themselves will be fixed. 
[*] When exchanging for gold in the “Exchange Memories of the Stars”, the issue where the exchange did not correctly update 
[*] The issue where clicking on a locked adventure level in the Adventure Guide displays incorrect text will be fixed.
[*] An issue where changing the language in Nightmares caused all owned missions to be displayed as “View Profile” will be fixed. 
[*] The issue where pressing the ESC key repeatedly before entering the Call of the Stars tutorial prevents progression will be fixed.
[*] In the Forgotten Mine, a problem where supporting with the same Knight of Veda that is already in the current team does not remove the duplicated Knight will be fixed.
[*] The issue where the game UI displays abnormally when network disconnection occurs on mobile devices during an Adventure Stage will be fixed.
[*] The problem where progression is not possible due to network disconnection on mobile devices during the loading screen after 3:3 Arena matching will be fixed.
[*] The issue where the crown indicating the player appears dimmed during 2:2 and 3:3 Arena matches will be fixed.
[*] The issue where Crown of Victory points were not displayed on the Arena ranking page will be fixed.
[*] The issue with the meaningless notification (exclamation mark) on the top left of the World Map will be fixed.
[b][*]The 4-set effect of the Relic [Sculptor of Despair](★3, ★4, ★5) will have some restrictions on its functionality. (Added April 17, 2024 5:44 PM)
(Previously) When blocking an attack, the stamina consumed was reduced by 40%, and 120% of the damage received was reflected.
(Now) When blocking an attack, the stamina consumed is reduced by 40%. Additionally, within 1 second after guarding, 120% of the damage received is reflected. [Added 4/17 08:58 UTC][/b]
[*] An issue where Arena’s Crown of Victory reset time was not updating properly has been identified and will be fixed. [Added 4/17 10:34 UTC]
[*]An error will be fixed where if an 'Apostle' monster appeared in a stage, it would always appear in additional attempts triggered by using Hero's Shoes, or if it did not appear, it would never appear in additional attempts. Now, the appearance probability will be properly reflected in additional attempts. (Added April 17, 2024 7:01 AM PDT, 02:01 PM UTC)

[/list]

[h1]■ Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] 「Adventurer's Ascent」 Knights of Veda Enhancement Package name and purchase conditions changes
- Adventurer's Ascent」 Knights of Veda Enhancement Package will be changed to 'Adventurer's Package.'
- 「Adventurer's Ascent」 The purchase conditions will be revised to allow purchases once every two weeks.
[/list]

Thank you

notes.title: Notice Regarding the Issue of Receiving Excessive Rewards in Co-op Play
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/79df9e8aebe9f3e68364cb7a1592b7f8e55222b9.png[/img]

Masters of the Book,

We have identified an issue where players receive more rewards than intended when claiming rewards using Hero's Shoes after clearing dungeons in co-op play.
This issue was addressed without downtime through a patch implemented on 4/16 at 12:11 AM (PDT)/4/16 07:11 AM (UTC). Given the urgency, we proceeded with the fix as quickly as possible.

Here's what happened:

[h3]Detailed Information:[/h3]
 - When clearing dungeons in co-op play, rewards were recognized as dropped for each party member, and using Hero's Shoes in this state resulted in receiving additional rewards proportional to the number of party members.
 - This issue occurred only after clearing in co-op play and using Hero's Shoes.
 - Only 'drop rewards' were affected; 'clear rewards' were not.

[h3]Example:[/h3]
 - If two players cleared a dungeon in co-op and then used Hero's Shoes, each player received an additional reward based on 'rewards for two people.'
 - If three players did so, each player received additional rewards based on 'rewards for three people.'

We apologize for the oversight and the inconvenience caused. Recognizing that no compensation can fully rectify the experience, yet we believe it is fair to equalize the opportunity without causing disappointment.
Therefore, we consider it most reasonable to provide Hero's Shoes to those who did not use them during co-op play.

 - We will compensate those who played solo, rather than in co-op, by providing them with Hero’s Shoes, to offset any potential disadvantage from not participating in co-op play.
 - Those who used Hero's Shoes in solo sessions instead of co-op will be compensated as if they had played solo.
 - For users who participated in both solo and co-op, we will adjust the compensation by deducting co-op plays from solo session rewards.

Lastly, to express our apologies, we will give 10 Crystals of Fate to all affected users.

We sincerely regret any inconvenience or dissatisfaction caused by this issue and will announce the detailed compensation and distribution dates as soon as data extraction is complete.


[h1]Additional Information on Co-op Related Compensation[/h1]

We would like to provide additional clarification regarding the compensation for co-op play that we previously discussed.

We plan to compensate all Masters of the Book, regardless of whether you participated in co-op play, by calculating any potential losses and awarding Hero's Shoes as compensation. Thus, compensation will be given not only for those who used Hero's Shoes but also for those who used regular shoes, regardless of whether you played in co-op or solo mode.

I apologize for any confusion caused by our previous explanations.
We will swiftly determine the exact number of instances and the level of compensation and provide further updates soon.

Once again, we apologize for any sense of loss or inconvenience caused by the game error.

Thank you for your understanding.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/79df9e8aebe9f3e68364cb7a1592b7f8e55222b9.png[/img]

Masters of the Book.

Today's temporary maintenance has successfully resolved the guild progress reward error. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this has caused in your use of guild content.

As previously announced, in our commitment to providing a fair and healthy gaming environment, we have completed an investigation related to this issue involving game data.

We have finished analyzing the game data regarding the reception of guild progress rewards to determine the extent of repeated claims by any account. The results confirm that the vast majority of you, Masters of the Book, did not exploit the bug allowing repeated reward claims and used the game as intended.

- Data investigation carried out up to the temporary blockage of guild progress rewards on April 11 at 05:56 AM (PDT) / 12:56 PM (UTC).
Out of 77,146 accounts that received guild progress rewards, approximately 99.9% (77,141 accounts) did not exploit the error.
- The following accounts were determined to have exploited this issue, and measures have been taken according to our game operation policy.

[h3]■ Details of Repeated Receipt of Guild Progress Rewards[/h3]

- A total of 5 accounts found to have claimed guild progress rewards more than 5 times.
 - More than 100 repetitions: 3 accounts
 - More than 5 repetitions: 2 accounts

[h3]■ Actions Taken[/h3]

- 3 accounts with more than 100 repetitions: Permanent game access restriction
- 2 accounts with more than 5 repetitions: 30-day game access restriction and retrieval of repeatedly acquired assets

Once again, we apologize for the inconvenience caused during your gameplay.

The development and operations team of "ASTRA: Knights of Veda" will continue to closely monitor and test future update content to prevent similar issues and strive to provide a more stable service environment and enjoyable content.

We will remain proactive in addressing any actions that exploit the game system and undermine the healthy gaming environment, and which cause deprivation to other Masters of the Book.

Thank you.

notes.title: Notice on Changes to the Game Content and Event Update Cycle
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/79df9e8aebe9f3e68364cb7a1592b7f8e55222b9.png[/img]

Hello, Masters of the Book,

Are you enjoying your unique and joyous adventure across the continent of Planis?

Through in-game messages, social media, and our official website, we've tried to keep you informed about the content and event schedules of ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

Based on user metrics and trends from various communities since launch, we aim to offer you more special and diverse experiences. As such, we kindly ask for your understanding as we plan to change the update cycle for future content and events as follows:

[b][Changes][/b]
Dates for various events and content updates will be altered.

- The first regular update scheduled for April 25th will now take place on April 18th. This adjustment has been made to swiftly improve aspects of the game you may have found inconvenient.

- The renewal dates for the Tower of Trials and the Quest Reset will be extended by 7 days. To allow more players to enjoy and sufficiently prepare for the Tower of Trials, its renewal cycle has been changed to 4 weeks. We will inform you in advance if there are adjustments to the renewal cycle in the future.

- The Arena season renewal date will be reduced by 7 days. With the "Crowns of Victory" acquisition amount increasing more than twofold and new content being added, we anticipate a lower difficulty in acquiring Crowns of Victory, prompting us to shorten the Arena season from 9 weeks to 8 weeks.

- The duration of the "Fateful Encounter" event will change from 6 weeks to 4 weeks. Following the end of this "Fateful Encounter" event, the next event will begin immediately. The event cycle has been adjusted so you can acquire attendance rewards more swiftly.

- The summoning periods for the Call of the Stars events "Black Sun" and "Veda's Gear" will be extended by 7 days. The period to acquire Xanthia will change from 3 weeks to 4 weeks, and the Call of the Stars event period will be set to 4 weeks thereafter.

- The "Journey in Memory" event period will be extended by 7 days. Corresponding to the Call of the Stars event period change, the Knight of Veda trial event period will also be adjusted to 4 weeks.

We apologize for any confusion caused by the changes to the content and event update schedule of ASTRA: Knights of Veda and commit to doing our best to meet your expectations moving forward.

Thank you.

notes.title: [Director’s Note] Thank you for your patience while we address the issues
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/d9584f71da4a41f954c70a084ef74d6d341d7a88.png[/img]

Hello, Masters of the Book,

I am Youngmo Kim, the director of ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

We apologize once again for the delay in addressing the various issues that have inconvenienced your gameplay experience since our launch.
The volume of issues and the potential side effects they could cause have necessitated careful and thus time-consuming corrections.

The maintenance on April 11th focused on addressing the most urgent issues and critical errors that could impact game balance, identified since our launch.

Despite our previous notice, we've had to make difficult decisions regarding errors causing some Knights of Veda to operate differently from our development intentions. These changes, we know, affect the gameplay you've become accustomed to, and after much deliberation, considering the long-term service of the game, we found it necessary to proceed with these corrections. Once more, we apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

Going forward, we are committed to resolving errors as swiftly as possible and will continue to offer satisfactory service through regular character balance patches and updates.

We will announce the regular update schedule and further details shortly. We're closely examining all community feedback and game data related to character balance to align with a direction that you, our players, find reasonable. 
Moreover, we will intensify our internal testing to prevent balance issues caused by bugs.

While we initially announced that the first regular update was scheduled for April 25th, we've opted to advance it to April 18th. Further details will be shared as soon as they're available.

To express our gratitude for your patience as we work through these issues, we've arranged a small token of appreciation:

[/list]

notes.title: 4/11 Patch Notes [Modified 04/11]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/abce9716716428194db288a31177041d62674291.png[/img]

Masters of the Book,

The first ASTRA: Knights of Veda patch notes. This update will focus on improving gameplay inconveniences that our Masters of the book are experiencing, before we look ahead to adding more gameplay features. Once this update is completed, we’ll be ready to unveil some of the new content that we have in store, so look forward to that! 

[h2]■ Improvements[/h2]
- The maximum number of shoes will be increased to 160, and their recharge time will be reduced to 8 minutes, allowing for more dungeon clears and rewards.
- Will add the ability to skip sections of the tutorial, so you only need to go through the sections that you feel are relevant to you.
- Difficulty of the tutorial will be adjusted to make it more enjoyable. 
- The 5★ Knight of Veda ‘Eliyar’ will use her Signature Skill in auto-battle, a setting that was previously available for manual play.   
- During auto-battle, it will be modified to automatically move to the statue of Veda after the battle is over. You will be able to quickly obtain rewards after the battle ends.
- The amount of Crowns of Victory earned in the arena will be adjusted, so aim for higher ranks through fierce Arena battles. 
The number of Crowns obtained upon winning/losing in the arena will be doubled.
The range of ranks that provide Crowns upon defeat will be increased from Trainee Knight 3 to Knight 4. 
- The rule in which matchmaking was based off the Master of the Book level will be improved to match based on the level of the Knights of Veda and equipped gear. We plan to provide a more refined and intense arena experience. 

[h2]■ Bug Fixes[/h2]
- The issue/error where Knights of Veda worked differently than intended will be fixed.
👉More Details:  https://astra.hybeim.com/en/news/notice/266 
- The issue where the visual effects for Marthel’s “Blessing of Lightning” did not show correctly will be fixed. 
- An issue where Sarka’s Signature Skills ground effect would inflict 100% interruption regardless of the target’s state will be rectified. 
- Orlik - The “down” effect applied to enemies hit by “Earth Smash” will be reduced from 4 seconds to 2.5 seconds.
- An issue where the Knight of Veda “Ardor” had pierce on his first attack will be fixed.
- The error where Knight of Veda 'Albert’s' signature skill causes 100% stagger to the target regardless of their state will be corrected.
- The issue with Knight of Veda 'Albert's' signature skill, where hitting a target within the teleport range causes 100% interruption regardless of the target's state, will be corrected.
- The issue will be corrected so that the buff from Knight of Veda ‘Ardor’s’ signature skill maintains its duration normally even when transformed into another Knight of Veda.
- Andrei’s 4★ weapon, Masterpiece of the House skill effect has been fixed.  [Added] 


We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the Knights of Veda acting irregularly, and will be sending all Masters of the Book Starstones x200 after the 4/11 maintenance. 


- You will be able to kick offline members from a Guild.  
- The issue where you could be asked to co-op in Nightmare and Sealed Dungeons, even with the “Allow Co-op Mode Invitation Search” turned to “Do not allow” will be remedied
- The issue where the remaining rubies are not automatically refreshed after recharging shoes will be fixed. 
- The issue where the ‘What's the mission on vibrant Tuesday?’ quest in the Reward Decree would not count will be fixed. 
- An issue will be fixed where the following achievements would not track progress correctly: 
“We’re Not Alone”, “Ride Away, Knight”, “Novice Relic Researcher”, “Ancient Relic Collector”.
- The problem where the outline of a summon remains after the summon dies in Arena will be fixed. 
- The issue where the system language and game language are displayed differently will be fixed. 
- An issue will be fixed where the score in Arena would not be shown on the victory screen if the game language is set to Japanese. 
- The issue where the description of the number of times for the Call of the Stars bonus rewards is incorrectly displayed when the game language is set to English will be corrected.
- An issue where the login authentication would be released if the login session expired will be fixed.
- The issue where canceling the age verification process when purchasing items with a Japanese national account prevents the purchase will be corrected.
- The issue where further enhancements do not proceed in certain situations after completing the Knight of Veda enhancement tutorial will be corrected.
- An issue that prevented normal game progression after expanding the formation page during the 'Beyond the Nightmare' tutorial will be fixed
- An issue where tapping the screen on the mobile reward acquisition result screen would not skip the animation will be fixed.
- An issue where selecting the 'Exit' button from the Belle menu would log the user out will be fixed.
- An issue where the camera would not operate correctly if the game was forcibly closed during the playback of the 'Day of Tragedy' video will be fixed.
- An adjustment will be made so that attempting to download additional files when there is no space on the device will not work. 
- The visibility of remaining purchase days for monthly/weekly items within the in-game store will be removed. 

We appreciate the support that you have shown for ASTRA: Knights of Veda, and we hope that the warming weather helps spur you on through the lands of Planis. 

Thank you

notes.title: Notice on Correction of Balance Errors for Knights of Veda
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/79df9e8aebe9f3e68364cb7a1592b7f8e55222b9.png[/img]

Masters of the Book,
This is the development team of ASTRA: Knights of Veda. We have discovered unintended errors in some Knights of Veda that were not intended by the development team and have proceeded with corrections. We sincerely apologize for not catching these issues before launch and would like to inform you about the corrections made:

[list]
[*] The issue where the signature skill effect of Knight of Veda ‘Marthel’ was not displayed has been corrected.
[*] The error in Knight of Veda ‘Sarka’s’ signature skill, which caused 100% interruption regardless of the target’s condition due to ground effects, has been corrected.
[*] The down time for enemies hit by Knight of Veda ‘Orlik’s’ signature skill has been balanced from 4 seconds to 2.5 seconds.
[*] The error where Knight of Veda ‘Ardor’ had an incorrect number of primary pierces set to 1 has been corrected.
[*] The issue with Knight of Veda ‘Albert’s’ signature skill causing 100% interruption to targets regardless of their condition has been corrected.
[/list]

In ASTRA: Knights of Veda's action system, interruption (reaction) occurs when the [Tenacity ATK] determined by weapon type * skill depletes all of a mob or Knight of Veda’s [Tenacity]. This [Tenacity ATK] and [Tenacity] are finely tuned, and the action taken also affects the [Tenacity] damage from [Tenacity ATK].

The problem with 'Sarka' and 'Albert' signature skills causing 100% interruption was due to a [forced interruption] feature intended for boss patterns, which was not properly normalized after being set for testing purposes on Knights of Veda, and was overlooked during testing and discovered post-service launch. If left as is, it could seriously affect PvP by canceling the opponent player's signature skills, necessitating an urgent correction.

Additionally, a balance adjustment has been made regarding 'Ardor’s' first normal attack arrow mistakenly set to pierce, diverging from the common specification that all ranged Knights' first hits do not pierce, and 'Orlik’s' signature skill causing a longer down time than intended in PvP when all hits connect.

We consider it a promise and principle to our players that the Knights of Veda designed at the time of the update operate as intended, preserving the value of all Knights. However, adjustments will be made as soon as possible if the following conditions apply:

For clear unintended setting errors, we will actively share information and make corrections.

For balance issues that could cause inconvenience or unfairness to many players, immediate adjustments will be made for serious matters with sufficient consensus, while for other issues, we will engage in ample discussion with players through appropriate communication channels, and adjustments will be made after a certain period of notice.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the Knights of Veda not functioning correctly. As a token of our apology, we will be sending 200 Starstones to all Masters of the Book after the maintenance on 4/11.

You have until Wednesday, 4/17 7:59 AM (PDT)/ 02:59 PM (UTC) to collect the rewards

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Responding to feedback from the Update Details Discussion Board!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/79df9e8aebe9f3e68364cb7a1592b7f8e55222b9.png[/img]

Hello, Masters of the Book,
This is the development team of "ASTRA: Knights of Veda."

On April 4th, we shared our first set of update patch notes and opened up a space on our Discord official community for your invaluable opinions.

We're deeply thankful to see so many Masters of the Book engaging with us, offering a wealth of perspectives. In light of your enthusiastic responses, we've formulated replies to the numerous points raised.

Beyond these responses, we're keenly listening to all you have to say and encourage your ongoing dialogue with us. We're committed to diligently assessing the scope of work and proposed changes to methodically implement enhancements.

Thank you for your unwavering support and thoughtful feedback.


[h3]1. Shortening the Recharge Time and Increasing the Max Number of Adventurer's Shoes [/h3]

We noticed that many shared concerns about the shortage of Adventurer's Shoes. We empathize with this issue and have been closely monitoring it while seeking directions for improvement in various aspects.

To quickly provide improvements in response to the overwhelming feedback, we plan to accelerate the recharge rate of Adventurer's Shoes from 9 minutes to 8 minutes in the April 11th update. Additionally, we will increase the maximum quantity that can be automatically recharged from 120 to 160.

As Adventurer's Shoes are a fundamental economic unit in ASTRA: Knights of Veda, excessive changes could lead to unintended consequences for the game's economy, so we will make these decisions and adjustments with great care.


[h3]2. Kicking Guild Member Changes[/h3]
The inability to kick guild members is an issue that the development team overlooked, and for that we are incredibly sorry. 

This issue is scheduled to be fixed through the April 11th update, and we will do our best to prevent similar occurrences happening in the future. 

[h3]3. Reward Decree “Knights of Arena” Change[/h3]
We’ve discovered a sizable portion of players feel compelled to participate in the arena due to the Reward Decree, even if they are not interested in PvP content. We empathize with the sentiment, which is why starting from the next Reward Decree season, missions requiring mandatory participation in the arena will be excluded. 

[h3]4. Balancing for Knights of Veda in Arena[/h3]
We have reviewed various opinions shared regarding the balance between melee and ranged Knights of Veda in Arena content. 

In the upcoming 4/18 update, we plan to introduce a feature that will switch between Knights of Veda automatically during Auto-play. Since melee characters perform better in auto situations than ranged, we need to take a multifaceted approach to balance. We’re reviewing the data as we get it, and plan adjustments to the balance with fairness in mind, ensuring that the individuality of Knights is maintained. 

[h3]5. Increasing the Quantity of Arena Crowns of Victory Earned[/h3]
Considering the perspective of Masters of the Book who may not favor Arena content, we initially set a higher difficulty for obtaining rewards from the Arena to address concerns about the rapid progression of Knights of Veda through Arena rewards being potentially unfair.

However, based on your feedback, we acknowledge that the current quantity of Crowns of Victory awarded may be too low, making it challenging to achieve progression rewards. Therefore, in the upcoming April 11th update, we will double the amount of Crowns of Victory earned and will closely monitor the situation going forward.

[h3]6. Streamlining the Call of the Stars screen[/h3]
 We are going to improve the Call of the Star’s screen to allow Masters of the Book to quickly review the results, enhancing the overall efficiency of the process. 

[h3]7. Improving the readability of Poison Attribute Damage[/h3]
We will improve the visual clarity of Poison attribute damage to make it easier to distinguish the effect on monsters. 

[h3]8. Improvements to the Description of Reward Decree Missions[/h3]
We have also noted feedback that the description of Reward Decree Missions is not intuitive or user-friendly. We will review the content to ensure it's easier for all Masters of the Book to understand and will continue to make improvements.

[h3]9. Weapon Refinement tool tips[/h3]
We are going to take a closer look at the current UI, and make the section easier to read. 

[h3]10. Steam Deck Support [/h3]
Steam Deck support is on our update schedule, and we’ll let you know when it’s ready. 

[h3]11. Add a button to exit a stage without consuming shoes when doing co-op[/h3]
To put this into context, a user expressed that they were unintentionally consuming shoes while helping friends, guild members and other Masters of the Book when doing co-op mode. 

While you can currently exit the stage without consuming Adventurer’s Shoes, by pressing the escape button on the top, we understand that as a force of habit, you’ll hit the Veda’s Return. 

For added convenience, we are currently considering adding a button which will allow you to exit a stage without consuming shoes. 

[h3]12. Adding the amount of Gold and Starstone information to the item information windows[/h3]
For those who need context, currently when looking at the Gold and Starstone tooltips, they currently do not display the total amount of these resources that you have. A suggestion came through to include this information, similar to other item tooltips. 

 This was an excellent suggestion, and we’ll be looking to implement it as soon as possible. 

[h3]13. Improving Skill Cooldown features for Knights[/h3]
We’ve seen quite a few comments regarding skill cooldowns, and the desire to have something to showcase that the skills are ready to be used again. We’re exploring options to improve this feature. 

[h3]14. Adding the Ability to Preset Equipment[/h3]
It seems that there have been discussions regarding the inconvenience of equipping gear while enhancing multiple Knights of Veda. In response, just like the formation presets for Knights of Veda, we will develop a preset feature that allows you to save and load equipment sets, including Relics.

[h3]15. Call of the Stars/ Arena History Review Feature[/h3]
We will review our current plans, and make space to add this to an update. We’ll let you know once it is added. 

[h3]16. Improving Skill Descriptions[/h3]
We will thoroughly review and improve skill descriptions with each update. 

[h3]17. Improving the Reward Screen Animation[/h3]
A feature to quickly skip the reward animation when pressed will be added on April 11th. We’ll continue to check other inconvenient aspects. 

[h3]18. Improving Controller Support[/h3]
We fully understand the inconvenience of having to use the mouse alongside a controller as expressed in feedback. 

Originally, we planned to enable the game to be fully controlled through a controller, including UI elements, but unfortunately this could not be implemented for launch. 

However we plan to address this issue, and make the game fully controller supported in future updates. These changes will be announced on our website when they are ready. 

[h3]19. Adding a Feature to Keep Current Co-Op Team[/h3]

This is something that the development team have also found quite inconvenient, and we will work to improve it as soon as possible. 

[h3]20. Introduction of Arena Co-Op and Friendly Matches[/h3]
We have noted numerous requests from users who wish to enjoy Arena content with friends. We fully recognize the need and will incorporate this into future development.

Additionally there have been numerous opinions regarding the readability of the UI, as well as improved options for chat and alert window notifications. 
We promise to promptly address any areas that Masters of the Book may find inconvenient, while balancing their importance and the time required for the implementation of these changes. These will then be reflected in our update schedule. 

Furthermore, we will not let this affect our planned new content and event updates, which aim to deliver various forms of enjoyment. 

The immense interest and support Masters of the Book have conveyed are a great source of motivation for the entire development team. We sincerely appreciate your valuable opinions and are committed to doing our best to reciprocate with improved services in the future.

Thank you.

notes.title: Developer Update Part 3
notes.content:
Hello Masters of the Book,

This is Flint’s development team for ASTRA: Knights of Veda.

As winter fades and a new season approaches, we're thrilled to share the forthcoming launch date for "ASTRA: Knights of Veda." 

We sincerely appreciate the patience and excitement that all of you who are eagerly anticipating the game's release have shown. Today, we're here to update you on the final development strides, particularly regarding improvements to the economic system and rewards.

[h1]Enhanced Farming Location Information[/h1]
In "ASTRA: Knights of Veda," materials required for improving your characters and weapons are crucial for progress. As these items are scattered across the lands of Planis, we've prioritized making this information more accessible.
Through the ‘Adventure Guide’, you can now easily see drop information for all areas. Clicking on any item in the Adventure Guide will take you to the stages you can get them, streamlining your farming experience. 
We've also refined the routes to align with character progression, ensuring a smoother and more engaging leveling experience. Adjustments to the drop rates and quantities of key items aim to minimize grinding stress, offering multiple ways to obtain materials. This flexibility allows for a tailored farming strategy based on your character's current development stage.

[h1]Material Acquisition Through Event Dungeons[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/fd8d57855ebf8ca8d84c23dcff01619867274a0b.png[/img]
In addition to regular adventures, you can acquire various materials through event dungeons that occur frequently in the Adventure Zone.
Gold can be acquired through the Calydon dungeon, and ores can be obtained through the mine dungeon.
Make sure to check these event dungeons out, as we work on preparing even more event dungeons for you to explore in the future.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/3b985753ae1b399d6f53ab95ee8a6a300d1ffd47.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/15689854f836c1e670f3be9cdff3aa396972a5be.png[/img]

[h1]Material Acquisition Through Various Missions[/h1]
There has been a lot of feedback that the rewards for missions are insufficient and the types of rewards are the same, making the choice meaningless.
In response, we've diversified the rewards for different types of missions and increased the quantities so that players can choose missions based on the materials they need.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/ebb9d54e6464d21b37ce59fde9f818080e79e087.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/17f0aa55ae92a55a5cf50d044769af2a79c103b4.png[/img]

[h1]Multiple Ways to Earn Starstones[/h1]
In "ASTRA: Knights of Veda," Starstones are a very important resource for acquiring characters and equipment. 
The feedback was that the first clear rewards for adventure dungeons were insufficient. In response, we’ve placed Starstones as rewards for clearing a stage for the first time and Starstones can also be earned by collecting trophies from adventure dungeons.
You can also earn Starstones by completing a variety of achievements.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/d9dcc1a334d334b43f59ae265197ad9ed0e5bf8d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/fb76496928f9810804312fb8266170e3c33e041c.png[/img]

[h1]Increased Drop Rate for Relics and Addition of Relic Enhancement Materials[/h1]
We recognized that it was difficult for players to collect and enhance relics, one of the key items in "ASTRA: Knights of Veda," due to their low drop rates. To improve this aspect of the game, we've boosted the drop rates of relics and added specialized enhancement materials, simplifying the process of setting up their relics. Additionally, we've converted essential materials from random drops to guaranteed drops, allowing players to plan their farming strategies more effectively.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44312056/e2740056ee1f1fd7a1f2a906eb4317781594f334.png[/img]

[h1]Implementing Auto-Play[/h1]
The "ASTRA: Knights of Veda" development team has made a pivotal enhancement based on comprehensive testing: the integration of auto-play. This addition aims to streamline game access and alleviate the tedium of repetitive farming, ensuring that gameplay remains engaging without compromising its depth. Auto-play manages the routine combat activities, but players will need to thoughtfully engage in character selection and timely dodging to navigate the challenges effectively.
While auto-play simplifies routine battles, strategic manual control remains essential for navigating the game's more challenging content, such as Nightmare Dungeons and Sealed Prisons, ensuring that the thrill of hands-on gameplay is preserved. This feature significantly reduces grind fatigue, allowing players to enjoy the rich storyline and diverse content more comfortably.

Note that the Arena, a core aspect of "ASTRA: Knights of Veda's" action-oriented gameplay, will continue to require manual control to maintain fairness and the integrity of competitive play.

Since the last FGBT, we've listened to quite a bit of feedback and made improvements accordingly, and now we're just waiting for you to see it for the first time.

"ASTRA: Knights of Veda" is a celebration of the 10th anniversary of "Dragon Blaze," marking it as a milestone project filled with enthusiasm and dedication from the development team. We have poured our hearts into crafting a game that lives up to your expectations and garners your continued support.
We’re incredibly excited to welcome you to the lands of Planis on April 2, 2024! We hope that the game brings you as much joy as we’ve had crafting it over the years. 

Thank you for your continued support.
Warm regards,
The "ASTRA: Knights of Veda" Development Team and Kim Youngmo
